WITH toy_products AS (
  SELECT product_id
  FROM products
  WHERE product_category_name = 'toys'
), daily_sales AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS order_date,
    SUM(order_items.price) AS total_sales
  FROM orders
  JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
  JOIN toy_products ON order_items.product_id = toy_products.product_id
  GROUP BY order_date
), train_data AS (
  SELECT
    order_date,
    JULIANDAY(order_date) AS day_num,
    total_sales
  FROM daily_sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2018-08-29'
), params AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(day_num) AS mean_x,
    AVG(total_sales) AS mean_y,
    (AVG(day_num * total_sales) - AVG(day_num) * AVG(total_sales)) / (AVG(day_num * day_num) - AVG(day_num) * AVG(day_num)) AS slope
  FROM train_data
), intercept_slope AS (
  SELECT
    mean_y - slope * mean_x AS intercept,
    slope
  FROM params
), predict_days(date) AS (
  VALUES
    ('2018-12-01'), ('2018-12-02'), ('2018-12-03'), ('2018-12-04'),
    ('2018-12-05'), ('2018-12-06'), ('2018-12-07'), ('2018-12-08')
), predicted_sales AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    intercept + slope * JULIANDAY(date) AS predicted_sale
  FROM predict_days, intercept_slope
), moving_avg_base AS (
  SELECT * FROM predicted_sales
  WHERE date BETWEEN '2018-12-01' AND '2018-12-08'
), moving_avg AS (
  SELECT
    m1.date,
    (SELECT AVG(m2.predicted_sale)
     FROM moving_avg_base m2
     WHERE m2.date BETWEEN DATE(m1.date, '-2 day') AND DATE(m1.date, '+2 day')) AS moving_avg_5d
  FROM moving_avg_base m1
  WHERE m1.date BETWEEN '2018-12-05' AND '2018-12-08'
)
SELECT SUM(moving_avg_5d) AS sum_of_4_moving_avgs FROM moving_avg;

WITH delivered_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    o.order_id,
    o.order_purchase_timestamp,
    op.payment_value
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
recency_calc AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_purchase
  FROM delivered_orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
recency_rank AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    last_purchase,
    JULIANDAY(MAX(last_purchase) OVER()) - JULIANDAY(last_purchase) AS recency_days
  FROM recency_calc
),
recency_score AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    last_purchase,
    recency_days,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY recency_days) AS recency
  FROM recency_rank
),
frequency_calc AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    COUNT(order_id) AS frequency
  FROM delivered_orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
frequency_score AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    frequency,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY frequency DESC) AS frequency_score
  FROM frequency_calc
),
monetary_calc AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    SUM(payment_value) AS monetary
  FROM delivered_orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
monetary_score AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    monetary,
    NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY monetary DESC) AS monetary_score
  FROM monetary_calc
),
rfm AS (
  SELECT 
    r.customer_id,
    r.recency,
    f.frequency_score AS frequency,
    m.monetary_score AS monetary,
    (f.frequency_score + m.monetary_score) AS freq_monetary_sum
  FROM recency_score r
  JOIN frequency_score f ON r.customer_id = f.customer_id
  JOIN monetary_score m ON r.customer_id = m.customer_id
),
rfm_segments AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    recency,
    frequency,
    monetary,
    freq_monetary_sum,
    CASE
      WHEN recency = 1 AND freq_monetary_sum BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Champions'
      WHEN recency IN (4,5) AND freq_monetary_sum BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'Can''t Lose Them'
      WHEN recency IN (4,5) AND freq_monetary_sum BETWEEN 3 AND 6 THEN 'Hibernating'
      WHEN recency IN (4,5) AND freq_monetary_sum BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'Lost'
      WHEN recency IN (2,3) AND freq_monetary_sum BETWEEN 1 AND 4 THEN 'Loyal Customers'
      WHEN recency = 3 AND freq_monetary_sum BETWEEN 5 AND 6 THEN 'Needs Attention'
      WHEN recency = 1 AND freq_monetary_sum BETWEEN 7 AND 8 THEN 'Recent Users'
      WHEN (recency = 1 AND freq_monetary_sum BETWEEN 5 AND 6) OR (recency = 2 AND freq_monetary_sum BETWEEN 5 AND 8) THEN 'Potential Loyalists'
      WHEN recency = 1 AND freq_monetary_sum BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Price Sensitive'
      WHEN recency = 2 AND freq_monetary_sum BETWEEN 9 AND 10 THEN 'Promising'
      WHEN recency = 3 AND freq_monetary_sum BETWEEN 7 AND 10 THEN 'About to Sleep'
      ELSE 'Others'
    END AS rfm_segment
  FROM rfm
),
avg_sales AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    SUM(payment_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS avg_sale_per_order
  FROM delivered_orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
)

SELECT
  s.rfm_segment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS num_customers,
  AVG(a.avg_sale_per_order) AS avg_sale_per_order
FROM rfm_segments s
JOIN avg_sales a ON s.customer_id = a.customer_id
GROUP BY s.rfm_segment
ORDER BY avg_sale_per_order DESC
LIMIT 1000;

WITH customer_order_stats AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS number_of_orders,
    AVG(op.payment_value) AS avg_payment_per_order,
    (julianday(MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) - julianday(MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp))) / 7.0 AS raw_lifespan_weeks
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_payments op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
customer_lifespans AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    number_of_orders,
    avg_payment_per_order,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_lifespan_weeks < 1 THEN 1.0
      ELSE raw_lifespan_weeks
    END AS lifespan_weeks
  FROM customer_order_stats
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  number_of_orders,
  avg_payment_per_order,
  lifespan_weeks
FROM customer_lifespans
ORDER BY avg_payment_per_order DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH career_spans AS (
  SELECT
    playerID,
    ROUND(ABS(strftime('%Y', finalGame) - strftime('%Y', debut)), 2) AS years_diff,
    ROUND(ABS(strftime('%m', finalGame) - strftime('%m', debut)) / 12.0, 2) AS months_diff,
    ROUND(ABS(strftime('%d', finalGame) - strftime('%d', debut)) / 365.0, 2) AS days_diff,
    ROUND(
      ROUND(ABS(strftime('%Y', finalGame) - strftime('%Y', debut)), 2) +
      ROUND(ABS(strftime('%m', finalGame) - strftime('%m', debut)) / 12.0, 2) +
      ROUND(ABS(strftime('%d', finalGame) - strftime('%d', debut)) / 365.0, 2),
      2
    ) AS career_span
  FROM player
  WHERE debut IS NOT NULL AND finalGame IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(career_span), 6) AS average_career_span_years
FROM career_spans;

WITH max_stats AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(G) AS max_games,
        MAX(R) AS max_runs,
        MAX(H) AS max_hits,
        MAX(HR) AS max_home_runs
    FROM batting
)
SELECT
    p.name_given,
    b.G AS games_played,
    b.R AS runs,
    b.H AS hits,
    b.HR AS home_runs
FROM player p
JOIN batting b ON p.player_id = b.player_id
JOIN max_stats ms ON 
    (b.G = ms.max_games OR
    b.R = ms.max_runs OR
    b.H = ms.max_hits OR
    b.HR = ms.max_home_runs)
ORDER BY
    b.G DESC,
    b.R DESC,
    b.H DESC,
    b.HR DESC;

WITH AbakanRoutes AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN f.departure_airport = a.code THEN a.city
      ELSE b.city
    END AS city1,
    CASE
      WHEN f.departure_airport = a.code THEN b.city
      ELSE a.city
    END AS city2,
    a.latitude AS lat1,
    a.longitude AS lon1,
    b.latitude AS lat2,
    b.longitude AS lon2
  FROM flights f
  JOIN airports_data a ON f.departure_airport = a.code
  JOIN airports_data b ON f.arrival_airport = b.code
  WHERE a.city = 'Abakan' OR b.city = 'Abakan'
),
SymmetrizedRoutes AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN city1 < city2 THEN city1 ELSE city2 END AS city1,
    CASE WHEN city1 < city2 THEN city2 ELSE city1 END AS city2,
    lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2
  FROM AbakanRoutes
),
Distances AS (
  SELECT
    city1,
    city2,
    2 * 6371 * ASIN(
      SQRT(
        POWER(SIN(RADIANS(lat2 - lat1) / 2), 2) +
        COS(RADIANS(lat1)) * COS(RADIANS(lat2)) *
        POWER(SIN(RADIANS(lon2 - lon1) / 2), 2)
      )
    ) AS distance_km
  FROM SymmetrizedRoutes
)
SELECT MAX(distance_km) AS max_distance_km
FROM Distances
;

WITH helmet_parties AS (
  SELECT
    case_id,
    party_number,
    CASE
      WHEN party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet%' OR party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet%' THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS wearing_helmet
  FROM parties
  WHERE party_type = 'motorcycle'
),
helmet_collisions AS (
  SELECT
    case_id,
    MAX(wearing_helmet) AS any_party_wearing_helmet
  FROM helmet_parties
  GROUP BY case_id
),
motorcycle_fatalities AS (
  SELECT
    v.case_id
  FROM victims v
  JOIN parties p ON v.case_id = p.case_id AND v.party_number = p.party_number
  WHERE p.party_type = 'motorcycle'
    AND v.victim_degree_of_injury = 'fatal'
),
fatality_counts AS (
  SELECT
    hc.any_party_wearing_helmet,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mf.case_id) AS motorcycle_fatalities
  FROM helmet_collisions hc
  LEFT JOIN motorcycle_fatalities mf ON hc.case_id = mf.case_id
  GROUP BY hc.any_party_wearing_helmet
),
collisions_counts AS (
  SELECT
    any_party_wearing_helmet,
    COUNT(*) AS total_collisions
  FROM helmet_collisions
  GROUP BY any_party_wearing_helmet
)
SELECT
  f.any_party_wearing_helmet AS helmet_usage,
  f.motorcycle_fatalities,
  c.total_collisions,
  ROUND(CAST(f.motorcycle_fatalities AS FLOAT) / c.total_collisions * 100, 2) AS fatality_rate_percent
FROM fatality_counts f
JOIN collisions_counts c ON f.any_party_wearing_helmet = c.any_party_wearing_helmet
ORDER BY helmet_usage DESC;

WITH yearly_cause_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    strftime('%Y', collision_date) AS year,
    primary_collision_factor AS cause,
    COUNT(*) AS cause_count
  FROM collisions
  GROUP BY year, cause
),

ranked_causes AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    cause,
    cause_count,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY cause_count DESC) AS cause_rank
  FROM yearly_cause_counts
),

most_common_causes AS (
  SELECT year, cause
  FROM ranked_causes
  WHERE cause_rank <= 2
  ORDER BY year, cause_rank
),

cause_years AS (
  SELECT year,
    GROUP_CONCAT(cause ORDER BY cause) AS two_most_common_causes
  FROM most_common_causes
  GROUP BY year
),

cause_pattern AS (
  SELECT two_most_common_causes,
         GROUP_CONCAT(year, ',') AS years
  FROM cause_years
  GROUP BY two_most_common_causes
  HAVING COUNT(year) = 1
)

SELECT years AS year_with_unique_top_2_causes
FROM cause_pattern
LIMIT 1;

WITH collision_factors_2011 AS (
  SELECT pcf_violation_category, COUNT(*) AS count_2011
  FROM collisions
  WHERE strftime('%Y', collision_date) = '2011'
  GROUP BY pcf_violation_category
),
collision_factors_2021 AS (
  SELECT pcf_violation_category, COUNT(*) AS count_2021
  FROM collisions
  WHERE strftime('%Y', collision_date) = '2021'
  GROUP BY pcf_violation_category
),
total_2011 AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_2011
  FROM collisions
  WHERE strftime('%Y', collision_date) = '2011'
),
total_2021 AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_2021
  FROM collisions
  WHERE strftime('%Y', collision_date) = '2021'
),
main_factor_2021 AS (
  SELECT pcf_violation_category, count_2021
  FROM collision_factors_2021
  ORDER BY count_2021 DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT 
  (100.0 * (cf_2011_share - cf_2021_share)) AS percentage_point_difference
FROM (
  SELECT
    mf.pcf_violation_category,
    CAST(cf_2011.count_2011 AS FLOAT) / t2011.total_2011 AS cf_2011_share,
    CAST(cf_2021.count_2021 AS FLOAT) / t2021.total_2021 AS cf_2021_share
  FROM main_factor_2021 mf
  JOIN collision_factors_2011 cf_2011 ON mf.pcf_violation_category = cf_2011.pcf_violation_category
  JOIN collision_factors_2021 cf_2021 ON mf.pcf_violation_category = cf_2021.pcf_violation_category
  JOIN total_2011 t2011
  JOIN total_2021 t2021
) diff
;

WITH NXT_matches AS (
    SELECT
        m.match_id,
        m.duration,
        w1.name AS wrestler1,
        w2.name AS wrestler2
    FROM Matches m
    JOIN Wrestlers w1 ON m.wrestler1_id = w1.wrestler_id
    JOIN Wrestlers w2 ON m.wrestler2_id = w2.wrestler_id
    JOIN Match_Types mt ON m.match_type_id = mt.match_type_id
    WHERE mt.name LIKE '%NXT%'
      AND mt.name NOT LIKE '%title change%'
),
Shortest_NXT_match AS (
    SELECT MIN(duration) AS shortest_duration FROM NXT_matches
)
SELECT wrestler1, wrestler2
FROM NXT_matches
WHERE duration = (SELECT shortest_duration FROM Shortest_NXT_match)
LIMIT 1;

WITH bowler_stats AS (
  SELECT
    wicket_taken.bowler_id,
    SUM(wicket_taken.economy_runs) AS total_runs_conceded,
    COUNT(wicket_taken.wicket_id) AS total_wickets
  FROM wicket_taken
  GROUP BY wicket_taken.bowler_id
),
bowling_average AS (
  SELECT
    bowler_id,
    total_runs_conceded * 1.0 / total_wickets AS bowling_avg
  FROM bowler_stats
  WHERE total_wickets > 0
)
SELECT 
  player.player_name,
  bowling_average.bowling_avg
FROM bowling_average
JOIN player ON bowling_average.bowler_id = player.player_id
ORDER BY bowling_average.bowling_avg ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH striker_runs AS (
  SELECT batsman, match_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs
  FROM batsman_scored
  GROUP BY batsman, match_id
  HAVING total_runs > 50
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs) AS avg_total_runs
FROM striker_runs;

WITH losing_teams AS (
  SELECT match_id, 
         CASE 
           WHEN match_winner = team_1 THEN team_2
           ELSE team_1
         END AS losing_team_id
  FROM match
), player_runs AS (
  SELECT pm.match_id, pm.player_id, pm.team_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
  FROM player_match pm
  JOIN batsman_scored bs 
    ON pm.match_id = bs.match_id
  -- Join ball_by_ball to get player_id who played each ball (batsman)
  JOIN ball_by_ball bb 
    ON bs.match_id = bb.match_id 
   AND bs.over_id = bb.over_id 
   AND bs.ball_id = bb.ball_id
  WHERE bb.batsman = pm.player_id
  GROUP BY pm.match_id, pm.player_id, pm.team_id
), losing_top_scorers AS (
  SELECT pr.player_id
  FROM player_runs pr
  JOIN losing_teams lt 
    ON pr.match_id = lt.match_id 
   AND pr.team_id = lt.losing_team_id
  WHERE pr.total_runs >= 100
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM losing_top_scorers lts
JOIN player p ON lts.player_id = p.player_id;

WITH player_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) AS matches_played,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON pm.player_id = bs.batsman_id AND pm.match_id = bs.match_id
    JOIN match m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season = 5
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.player_id,
        pr.total_runs * 1.0 / pr.matches_played AS avg_runs_per_match
    FROM player_runs pr
    WHERE pr.matches_played > 0
),
batting_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN wt.wicket_type IN ('bowled', 'caught', 'lbw', 'stumped', 'hit wicket') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS batting_average
    FROM player_match pm
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON pm.player_id = bs.batsman_id AND pm.match_id = bs.match_id
    LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bs.match_id = wt.match_id AND bs.batsman_id = wt.player_out
    JOIN match m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.season = 5
    GROUP BY pm.player_id
)
SELECT p.player_name, pa.avg_runs_per_match, ba.batting_average
FROM player_averages pa
JOIN batting_avg ba ON pa.player_id = ba.player_id
JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id
ORDER BY pa.avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH PlayerMatchRuns AS (
    SELECT 
        pm.player_id, 
        pm.match_id,
        SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS runs_per_match
    FROM player_match pm
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON pm.player_id = bs.batsman_id AND pm.match_id = bs.match_id
    GROUP BY pm.player_id, pm.match_id
),
PlayerAverage AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        AVG(runs_per_match) AS avg_runs_per_match
    FROM PlayerMatchRuns
    GROUP BY player_id
),
CountryPlayerAverage AS (
    SELECT 
        p.country,
        AVG(pa.avg_runs_per_match) AS country_avg_batting
    FROM PlayerAverage pa
    JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id
    GROUP BY p.country
)
SELECT 
    country,
    country_avg_batting
FROM CountryPlayerAverage
ORDER BY country_avg_batting DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH over_runs AS (
  SELECT
    m.match_id,
    b.inning,
    b.over,
    SUM(bs.runs) AS batsman_runs,
    COALESCE(SUM(e.extra_runs), 0) AS extra_runs
  FROM
    match m
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON m.match_id = b.match_id
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.inning = bs.inning AND b.over = bs.over AND b.ball = bs.ball
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs e ON b.match_id = e.match_id AND b.inning = e.inning AND b.over = e.over AND b.ball = e.ball
  GROUP BY
    m.match_id,
    b.inning,
    b.over
),
over_with_bowler AS (
  SELECT
    o.match_id,
    o.inning,
    o.over,
    o.batsman_runs + o.extra_runs AS total_runs,
    bb.bowler
  FROM
    over_runs o
    JOIN (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        match_id,
        inning,
        over,
        bowler
      FROM
        ball_by_ball
    ) bb ON o.match_id = bb.match_id AND o.inning = bb.inning AND o.over = bb.over
),
max_over_per_match_inning AS (
  SELECT
    match_id,
    inning,
    total_runs,
    bowler
  FROM (
    SELECT
      match_id,
      inning,
      total_runs,
      bowler,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY total_runs DESC, bowler) AS rn
    FROM
      over_with_bowler
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
),
max_over_per_match AS (
  SELECT
    match_id,
    total_runs,
    bowler
  FROM (
    SELECT
      match_id,
      total_runs,
      bowler,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC) AS rn
    FROM
      max_over_per_match_inning
  )
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  AVG(total_runs) AS average_highest_over_total_runs
FROM
  max_over_per_match;

WITH max_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        over,
        SUM(runs) AS total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball
    GROUP BY match_id, over
),
max_over_runs_per_match AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        MAX(total_runs) AS max_runs
    FROM max_runs_per_match
    GROUP BY match_id
),
max_run_overs AS (
    SELECT
        m.match_id,
        m.over,
        m.total_runs
    FROM max_runs_per_match m
    JOIN max_over_runs_per_match r
      ON m.match_id = r.match_id AND m.total_runs = r.max_runs
),
bowler_runs_in_max_overs AS (
    SELECT
        m.match_id,
        m.over,
        b.bowler,
        SUM(b.runs) AS bowler_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN max_run_overs m
      ON b.match_id = m.match_id AND b.over = m.over
    GROUP BY m.match_id, m.over, b.bowler
),
top_bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        bowler,
        MAX(bowler_runs) AS max_runs_single_over
    FROM bowler_runs_in_max_overs
    GROUP BY match_id, bowler
)
SELECT
    bowler,
    match_id,
    max_runs_single_over
FROM top_bowler_runs
ORDER BY max_runs_single_over DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
  strftime('%m', order_delivered_customer_date) AS month,
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', order_delivered_customer_date) = '2016' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "2016",
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', order_delivered_customer_date) = '2017' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "2017",
  SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', order_delivered_customer_date) = '2018' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "2018"
FROM olist_orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
  AND strftime('%Y', order_delivered_customer_date) IN ('2016', '2017', '2018')
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_unique_id,
        o.order_id
    FROM olist_orders o
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
customer_order_counts AS (
    SELECT
        do.customer_unique_id,
        COUNT(do.order_id) AS delivered_order_count
    FROM delivered_orders do
    GROUP BY do.customer_unique_id
),
top_customers AS (
    SELECT
        customer_unique_id
    FROM customer_order_counts
    ORDER BY delivered_order_count DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
customer_payment_agg AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_unique_id,
        AVG(op.payment_value) AS avg_payment_value
    FROM olist_order_payments op
    JOIN olist_orders o ON op.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.customer_unique_id IN (SELECT customer_unique_id FROM top_customers)
    GROUP BY o.customer_unique_id
),
customer_location AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_unique_id,
        c.customer_city,
        c.customer_state
    FROM olist_customers c
    WHERE c.customer_unique_id IN (SELECT customer_unique_id FROM top_customers)
)
SELECT
    tc.customer_unique_id,
    coc.delivered_order_count,
    cpa.avg_payment_value,
    cl.customer_city AS city,
    cl.customer_state AS state
FROM top_customers tc
JOIN customer_order_counts coc ON tc.customer_unique_id = coc.customer_unique_id
JOIN customer_payment_agg cpa ON tc.customer_unique_id = cpa.customer_unique_id
JOIN customer_location cl ON tc.customer_unique_id = cl.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY coc.delivered_order_count DESC;

WITH city_payments_orders AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_city AS city,
    SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_payments,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_delivered_orders
  FROM olist_customers c
  JOIN olist_orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN olist_order_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY c.customer_city
),
lowest_five_cities AS (
  SELECT city, total_payments, total_delivered_orders
  FROM city_payments_orders
  ORDER BY total_payments ASC
  LIMIT 5
)
SELECT
  AVG(total_payments) AS avg_of_total_payments,
  AVG(total_delivered_orders) AS avg_of_total_delivered_orders
FROM lowest_five_cities;

WITH yearly_delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) AS year,
        COUNT(order_id) AS delivered_orders_count
    FROM olist_orders
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
      AND strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) IN ('2016', '2017', '2018')
    GROUP BY year
),
lowest_year AS (
    SELECT year
    FROM yearly_delivered_orders
    ORDER BY delivered_orders_count
    LIMIT 1
),
monthly_delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) AS year,
        strftime('%m', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
        COUNT(order_id) AS monthly_delivered_orders_count
    FROM olist_orders
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
      AND strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) IN ('2016', '2017', '2018')
    GROUP BY year, month
)
SELECT MAX(monthly_delivered_orders_count) AS highest_monthly_delivered_orders_volume
FROM monthly_delivered_orders
WHERE year = (SELECT year FROM lowest_year);

WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, o.seller_id
    FROM olist_orders o
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
order_details AS (
    SELECT oi.order_id, oi.seller_id, oi.price, oi.freight_value
    FROM olist_order_items oi
),
order_reviews_filtered AS (
    SELECT o.order_id, o.seller_id, r.review_score
    FROM delivered_orders o
    JOIN olist_order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
),
distinct_customers AS (
    SELECT seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_customer_count
    FROM delivered_orders
    GROUP BY seller_id
    ORDER BY distinct_customer_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
highest_profit AS (
    SELECT seller_id, SUM(price - freight_value) AS total_profit
    FROM order_details
    WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM delivered_orders)
    GROUP BY seller_id
    ORDER BY total_profit DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
distinct_orders AS (
    SELECT seller_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS distinct_order_count
    FROM order_details
    WHERE order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM delivered_orders)
    GROUP BY seller_id
    ORDER BY distinct_order_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
top_5star_reviews AS (
    SELECT seller_id, COUNT(*) AS five_star_count
    FROM order_reviews_filtered
    WHERE review_score = 5
    GROUP BY seller_id
    ORDER BY five_star_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 'Seller with the highest number of distinct customers' AS achievement, seller_id, distinct_customer_count AS value
FROM distinct_customers
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Seller with the highest profit (price - freight_value)' AS achievement, seller_id, total_profit AS value
FROM highest_profit
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Seller with the highest number of distinct orders' AS achievement, seller_id, distinct_order_count AS value
FROM distinct_orders
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Seller with the most 5-star ratings' AS achievement, seller_id, five_star_count AS value
FROM top_5star_reviews;

WITH category_payment_count AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_category_name,
        op.payment_type,
        COUNT(op.payment_type) AS payment_count
    FROM olist_order_payments op
    JOIN olist_order_items oi ON op.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN olist_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_category_name, op.payment_type
),
ranked_payments AS (
    SELECT
        product_category_name,
        payment_type,
        payment_count,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_name ORDER BY payment_count DESC) AS rank
    FROM category_payment_count
),
most_preferred_payments AS (
    SELECT
        product_category_name,
        payment_type,
        payment_count
    FROM ranked_payments
    WHERE rank = 1
)
SELECT
    AVG(payment_count) AS avg_payments_for_most_preferred_method
FROM most_preferred_payments;

WITH OrderedCities AS (
  SELECT
    geolocation_state,
    geolocation_city,
    geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
    geolocation_lat,
    geolocation_lng,
    LAG(geolocation_lat) OVER (
      ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng
    ) AS prev_lat,
    LAG(geolocation_lng) OVER (
      ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng
    ) AS prev_lng,
    LAG(geolocation_city) OVER (
      ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng
    ) AS prev_city,
    LAG(geolocation_state) OVER (
      ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng
    ) AS prev_state
  FROM olist_geolocation
),
Distances AS (
  SELECT
    geolocation_state,
    geolocation_city,
    prev_state,
    prev_city,
    -- Convert degrees to radians: degrees * PI()/180
    6371 * ACOS(
      COS(RADIANS(prev_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(geolocation_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(geolocation_lng) - RADIANS(prev_lng))
      + SIN(RADIANS(prev_lat)) * SIN(RADIANS(geolocation_lat))
    ) AS distance_km
  FROM OrderedCities
  WHERE prev_lat IS NOT NULL AND prev_lng IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  prev_state AS state1,
  prev_city AS city1,
  geolocation_state AS state2,
  geolocation_city AS city2,
  distance_km
FROM Distances
ORDER BY distance_km DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH category_payment_counts AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_category_name,
    op.payment_type,
    COUNT(*) AS payment_count
  FROM
    olist_order_payments op
  JOIN
    olist_orders o ON op.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN
    olist_order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN
    olist_products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  GROUP BY
    p.product_category_name,
    op.payment_type
),
category_top_payment AS (
  SELECT
    product_category_name,
    payment_type,
    payment_count,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_name ORDER BY payment_count DESC) AS rnk
  FROM
    category_payment_counts
),
category_most_common_payment AS (
  SELECT
    product_category_name,
    payment_type,
    payment_count
  FROM
    category_top_payment
  WHERE
    rnk = 1
)
SELECT
  product_category_name,
  payment_type,
  payment_count
FROM
  category_most_common_payment
ORDER BY
  payment_count DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH EligibleFilms AS (
    SELECT f.film_id
    FROM film f
    JOIN language l ON f.language_id = l.language_id
    JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id
    JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id
    WHERE l.name = 'English'
      AND c.name = 'Children'
      AND (f.rating = 'G' OR f.rating = 'PG')
      AND f.length <= 120
      AND f.release_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2010
), ActorFilmCounts AS (
    SELECT fa.actor_id, COUNT(*) AS film_count
    FROM film_actor fa
    JOIN EligibleFilms ef ON fa.film_id = ef.film_id
    GROUP BY fa.actor_id
)
SELECT a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name AS actor_full_name
FROM ActorFilmCounts afc
JOIN actor a ON afc.actor_id = a.actor_id
ORDER BY afc.film_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH CityAorHyphen AS (
  SELECT city_id
  FROM city
  WHERE city LIKE 'A%' OR city LIKE '%-%'
),
RentalHoursByCategory AS (
  SELECT fc.category_id,
         SUM(julianday(r.return_date) - julianday(r.rental_date)) AS total_rental_hours
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id
  JOIN store s ON i.store_id = s.store_id
  JOIN address a ON s.address_id = a.address_id
  WHERE a.city_id IN (SELECT city_id FROM CityAorHyphen)
  GROUP BY fc.category_id
),
MaxRentalCategory AS (
  SELECT category_id
  FROM RentalHoursByCategory
  ORDER BY total_rental_hours DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT c.name AS film_category_with_highest_rental_hours
FROM category c
JOIN MaxRentalCategory mrc ON c.category_id = mrc.category_id;

WITH combined_data AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(t.zipcode, i.zipcode) AS zipcode,
    t.boroname,
    t.tree_id,
    i.Estimate_Median_income AS median_income,
    i.Estimate_Mean_income AS mean_income
  FROM trees t
  LEFT JOIN income_trees i ON t.zipcode = i.zipcode
  UNION
  SELECT
    COALESCE(t.zipcode, i.zipcode) AS zipcode,
    t.boroname,
    t.tree_id,
    i.Estimate_Median_income AS median_income,
    i.Estimate_Mean_income AS mean_income
  FROM income_trees i
  LEFT JOIN trees t ON i.zipcode = t.zipcode
),
filtered_data AS (
  SELECT * FROM combined_data
  WHERE median_income > 0
    AND mean_income > 0
    AND boroname IS NOT NULL
    AND boroname != ''
),
borough_tree_counts AS (
  SELECT
    boroname,
    COUNT(tree_id) AS tree_count,
    AVG(mean_income) AS avg_mean_income
  FROM filtered_data
  GROUP BY boroname
  ORDER BY tree_count DESC
  LIMIT 3
)
SELECT boroname, tree_count, avg_mean_income
FROM borough_tree_counts;

WITH bronx_trees AS (
  SELECT health
  FROM trees
  WHERE boroname = 'Bronx'
), 
count_totals AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM bronx_trees
),
count_good AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS good FROM bronx_trees WHERE health = 'Good'
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * good / total, 2) AS pct_good
FROM count_totals, count_good;

WITH unicorns AS (
    SELECT f.company_id, i.industry, d.year_founded
    FROM companies_funding f
    JOIN companies_industries i ON f.company_id = i.company_id
    JOIN companies_dates d ON f.company_id = d.company_id
    WHERE f.valuation >= 1000000000
      AND d.year_founded BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021
),
industry_counts AS (
    SELECT industry, COUNT(DISTINCT company_id) AS unicorn_count
    FROM unicorns
    GROUP BY industry
),
top_industry AS (
    SELECT industry
    FROM industry_counts
    ORDER BY unicorn_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
unicorns_in_top_industry AS (
    SELECT year_founded, COUNT(DISTINCT company_id) AS new_unicorns
    FROM unicorns
    WHERE industry = (SELECT industry FROM top_industry)
    GROUP BY year_founded
)
SELECT AVG(new_unicorns) AS avg_new_unicorns_per_year
FROM unicorns_in_top_industry;

WITH france_country AS (
  SELECT country_id
  FROM countries
  WHERE country_name = 'France'
  LIMIT 1
),
filtered_sales AS (
  SELECT
    s.prod_id,
    t.calendar_year AS year,
    t.calendar_month_number AS month,
    SUM(s.amount_sold) AS total_amount_sold
  FROM sales s
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  CROSS JOIN france_country fc
  WHERE s.promo_id = 1
    AND s.channel_id = 1
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
  GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number
),
growth_calc AS (
  SELECT
    fs2019.prod_id,
    fs2019.month,
    fs2019.total_amount_sold AS sales_2019,
    IFNULL(fs2020.total_amount_sold, 0) AS sales_2020,
    CASE WHEN fs2019.total_amount_sold = 0 THEN 0
         ELSE ((fs2020.total_amount_sold - fs2019.total_amount_sold) * 1.0 / fs2019.total_amount_sold) END AS growth_rate
  FROM filtered_sales fs2019
  LEFT JOIN filtered_sales fs2020 ON fs2019.prod_id = fs2020.prod_id AND fs2019.month = fs2020.month AND fs2020.year = 2020
  WHERE fs2019.year = 2019
),
projected_2021 AS (
  SELECT
    gc.prod_id,
    gc.month,
    ((gc.growth_rate * gc.sales_2020) + gc.sales_2020) AS projected_sales
  FROM growth_calc gc
),
monthly_avg_sales AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    AVG(projected_sales) AS avg_sales
  FROM projected_2021
  GROUP BY month
),
currency_2021 AS (
  SELECT
    c.month,
    c.to_us AS exchange_rate
  FROM currency c
  WHERE c.year = 2021
    AND c.country = 'France'
),
monthly_avg_usd AS (
  SELECT
    m.month,
    ROUND(m.avg_sales * COALESCE(c.exchange_rate, 1), 2) AS avg_sales_usd
  FROM monthly_avg_sales m
  LEFT JOIN currency_2021 c ON m.month = c.month
),
median_value AS (
  SELECT avg_sales_usd
  FROM monthly_avg_usd
  ORDER BY avg_sales_usd
  LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM monthly_avg_usd) / 2
)
SELECT avg_sales_usd AS median_avg_monthly_projected_sales_usd
FROM median_value;

WITH BestSellingArtist AS (
    SELECT a.artistid
    FROM artists a
    JOIN albums al ON a.artistid = al.artistid
    JOIN tracks t ON al.albumid = t.albumid
    JOIN invoice_items ii ON t.trackid = ii.trackid
    GROUP BY a.artistid
    ORDER BY SUM(ii.unitprice * ii.quantity) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
CustomerSpending AS (
    SELECT c.customerid, c.firstname, SUM(ii.unitprice * ii.quantity) AS spent_amount
    FROM customers c
    JOIN invoices inv ON c.customerid = inv.customerid
    JOIN invoice_items ii ON inv.invoiceid = ii.invoiceid
    JOIN tracks t ON ii.trackid = t.trackid
    JOIN albums al ON t.albumid = al.albumid
    WHERE al.artistid = (SELECT artistid FROM BestSellingArtist)
    GROUP BY c.customerid
)
SELECT firstname, spent_amount
FROM CustomerSpending
WHERE spent_amount < 1;

WITH ArtistSales AS (
  SELECT ar.ArtistId, ar.Name AS ArtistName, SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS TotalSales
  FROM artists ar
  JOIN albums al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId
  JOIN tracks t ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
  JOIN invoice_items ii ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
  GROUP BY ar.ArtistId
),
RankedArtists AS (
  SELECT ArtistId, ArtistName, TotalSales,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalSales DESC, ArtistName ASC) AS RankDesc,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalSales ASC, ArtistName ASC) AS RankAsc
  FROM ArtistSales
),
TopArtist AS (
  SELECT ArtistId, ArtistName FROM RankedArtists WHERE RankDesc = 1
),
LowestArtist AS (
  SELECT ArtistId, ArtistName FROM RankedArtists WHERE RankAsc = 1
),
CustomerSpending AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, ar.ArtistId, SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS AmountSpent
  FROM customers c
  JOIN invoices iv ON c.CustomerId = iv.CustomerId
  JOIN invoice_items ii ON iv.InvoiceId = ii.InvoiceId
  JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
  JOIN albums al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
  JOIN artists ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId
  WHERE ar.ArtistId IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM TopArtist UNION SELECT ArtistId FROM LowestArtist)
  GROUP BY c.CustomerId, ar.ArtistId
),
AvgSpending AS (
  SELECT ArtistId, AVG(AmountSpent) AS AvgSpent
  FROM CustomerSpending
  GROUP BY ArtistId
)
SELECT ABS(
  (SELECT AvgSpent FROM AvgSpending WHERE ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM TopArtist)) -
  (SELECT AvgSpent FROM AvgSpending WHERE ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM LowestArtist))
) AS AbsoluteDifference;

WITH monthly_payments AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id, 
    strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date) AS year_month, 
    AVG(amount) AS avg_monthly_amount
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY customer_id, year_month
), monthly_changes AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id, 
    year_month, 
    avg_monthly_amount,
    LAG(avg_monthly_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY year_month) AS prev_avg
  FROM monthly_payments
), monthly_diffs AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id, 
    ABS(avg_monthly_amount - prev_avg) AS monthly_change
  FROM monthly_changes
  WHERE prev_avg IS NOT NULL
), avg_monthly_change AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id, 
    AVG(monthly_change) AS avg_monthly_change
  FROM monthly_diffs
  GROUP BY customer_id
), max_change AS (
  SELECT MAX(avg_monthly_change) AS max_avg_change FROM avg_monthly_change
)
SELECT c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name AS full_name
FROM avg_monthly_change amc
JOIN max_change mc ON amc.avg_monthly_change = mc.max_avg_change
JOIN customer c ON amc.customer_id = c.customer_id;

WITH product_counts AS (
  SELECT
    p.segment,
    sf.fiscal_year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sf.product_code) AS unique_product_count
  FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly sf
  JOIN hardware_dim_product p ON sf.product_code = p.product_code
  WHERE sf.fiscal_year IN (2020, 2021)
  GROUP BY p.segment, sf.fiscal_year
),
pct_increase AS (
  SELECT
    c2020.segment,
    c2020.unique_product_count AS unique_2020,
    c2021.unique_product_count AS unique_2021,
    CASE
      WHEN c2020.unique_product_count = 0 THEN NULL
      ELSE (c2021.unique_product_count - c2020.unique_product_count) * 1.0 / c2020.unique_product_count
    END AS pct_increase
  FROM product_counts c2020
  LEFT JOIN product_counts c2021 ON c2020.segment = c2021.segment AND c2021.fiscal_year = 2021
  WHERE c2020.fiscal_year = 2020
)
SELECT
  segment,
  unique_2020
FROM pct_increase
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC;

WITH sales_2021 AS (
    SELECT p.division, s.product_code, SUM(s.sold_quantity) AS total_quantity
    FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly s
    JOIN hardware_dim_product p ON s.product_code = p.product_code
    WHERE s.fiscal_year = 2021
    GROUP BY p.division, s.product_code
),
top3_products AS (
    SELECT division, product_code, total_quantity,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY division ORDER BY total_quantity DESC) AS rank
    FROM sales_2021
),
top3_per_division AS (
    SELECT division, product_code
    FROM top3_products
    WHERE rank <= 3
),
average_top3 AS (
    SELECT p.division, AVG(s.sold_quantity) AS avg_quantity
    FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly s
    JOIN top3_per_division t ON s.product_code = t.product_code
    JOIN hardware_dim_product p ON s.product_code = p.product_code
    WHERE s.fiscal_year = 2021 AND p.division = t.division
    GROUP BY p.division
)
SELECT division, avg_quantity
FROM average_top3
ORDER BY division;

WITH sales_us AS (
  SELECT cu.cust_city AS city, s.prod_id, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_quarter_number AS quarter, SUM(s.amount_sold) AS total_sales
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
  JOIN countries co ON cu.country_id = co.country_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'United States' 
    AND s.promo_id = 0
    AND ((t.calendar_year = 2019 AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4) OR (t.calendar_year = 2020 AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4))
  GROUP BY cu.cust_city, s.prod_id, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_quarter_number
),
city_sales AS (
  SELECT sales_us.city,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sales_us.calendar_year = 2019 THEN sales_us.total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2019,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sales_us.calendar_year = 2020 THEN sales_us.total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2020
  FROM sales_us
  GROUP BY sales_us.city
  HAVING sales_2020 >= sales_2019 * 1.2
),
filtered_products AS (
  SELECT su.city, su.prod_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN su.calendar_year = 2019 THEN su.total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2019,
    SUM(CASE WHEN su.calendar_year = 2020 THEN su.total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2020
  FROM sales_us su
  JOIN city_sales cs ON su.city = cs.city
  GROUP BY su.city, su.prod_id
),
products_ranked AS (
  SELECT fp.city, fp.prod_id, fp.sales_2019, fp.sales_2020,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fp.city ORDER BY (fp.sales_2019 + fp.sales_2020) DESC) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY fp.city) AS cnt
  FROM filtered_products fp
),
top_products AS (
  SELECT city, prod_id, sales_2019, sales_2020
  FROM products_ranked
  WHERE rn <= CEIL(cnt * 0.2)
),
city_totals AS (
  SELECT su.city,
    SUM(CASE WHEN su.calendar_year = 2019 THEN su.total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS total_2019,
    SUM(CASE WHEN su.calendar_year = 2020 THEN su.total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS total_2020
  FROM sales_us su
  JOIN city_sales cs ON su.city = cs.city
  GROUP BY su.city
),
product_shares AS (
  SELECT tp.city, tp.prod_id,
  tp.sales_2019 * 1.0 / ct.total_2019 AS share_2019,
  tp.sales_2020 * 1.0 / ct.total_2020 AS share_2020,
  tp.sales_2020 * 1.0 / ct.total_2020 - tp.sales_2019 * 1.0 / ct.total_2019 AS share_change
  FROM top_products tp
  JOIN city_totals ct ON tp.city = ct.city
)

SELECT city, prod_id AS product_id, share_2019, share_2020, share_change
FROM product_shares
ORDER BY share_change DESC
LIMIT 1000;

WITH filtered_sales AS (
    SELECT
        sales.prod_id,
        countries.country_id,
        times.calendar_year AS year,
        times.calendar_month_number AS month,
        sales.amount_sold,
        promotions.promo_total_id,
        channels.channel_total_id
    FROM sales
    JOIN countries ON sales.cust_id = countries.country_id
    JOIN promotions ON sales.promo_id = promotions.promo_id
    JOIN channels ON sales.channel_id = channels.channel_id
    JOIN times ON sales.time_id = times.time_id
    WHERE countries.country_name = 'France'
      AND promotions.promo_total_id = 1
      AND channels.channel_total_id = 1
      AND times.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
),
sales_agg AS (
    SELECT
        prod_id,
        year,
        month,
        SUM(amount_sold) AS total_sales
    FROM filtered_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, year, month
),
sales_2019 AS (
    SELECT prod_id, month, total_sales AS sales_2019
    FROM sales_agg
    WHERE year = 2019
),
sales_2020 AS (
    SELECT prod_id, month, total_sales AS sales_2020
    FROM sales_agg
    WHERE year = 2020
),
projected_2021 AS (
    SELECT
        s20.prod_id,
        s20.month,
        s20.sales_2020,
        COALESCE(s19.sales_2019, 0) AS sales_2019,
        CASE 
            WHEN s19.sales_2019 = 0 THEN s20.sales_2020
            ELSE (((s20.sales_2020 - s19.sales_2019) * s20.sales_2020) / s19.sales_2019) + s20.sales_2020
        END AS projected_sales
    FROM sales_2020 s20
    LEFT JOIN sales_2019 s19 ON s20.prod_id = s19.prod_id AND s20.month = s19.month
),
currency_2021 AS (
    SELECT
        country AS country_name,
        year,
        month,
        to_us AS exchange_rate_to_usd
    FROM currency
    WHERE country = 'France' AND year = 2021
),
sales_2021_converted AS (
    SELECT
        p.month,
        p.projected_sales,
        c.exchange_rate_to_usd,
        (p.projected_sales * COALESCE(c.exchange_rate_to_usd, 1)) AS projected_sales_usd
    FROM projected_2021 p
    LEFT JOIN currency_2021 c ON p.month = c.month
)
SELECT
    month,
    ROUND(AVG(projected_sales_usd), 2) AS avg_projected_sales_usd
FROM sales_2021_converted
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

WITH Italian_Customers_Profit AS (
    SELECT
        c.cust_id,
        SUM(s.quantity_sold * (s.amount_sold / s.quantity_sold - p.prod_min_price)) AS total_profit
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN countries cn ON c.country_id = cn.country_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    WHERE cn.country_name = 'Italy'
      AND t.calendar_year = 2021
      AND t.calendar_month_number = 12
    GROUP BY c.cust_id
),
Profit_Buckets AS (
    SELECT
        cust_id,
        total_profit,
        NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY total_profit) AS profit_bucket
    FROM Italian_Customers_Profit
),
Bucket_Summary AS (
    SELECT
        profit_bucket,
        COUNT(cust_id) AS num_customers,
        MIN(total_profit) AS min_total_profit,
        MAX(total_profit) AS max_total_profit
    FROM Profit_Buckets
    GROUP BY profit_bucket
    ORDER BY profit_bucket
)
SELECT * FROM Bucket_Summary;

WITH sales_us AS (
  SELECT 
    s.prod_id,
    c.cust_city AS city,
    t.calendar_quarter_id,
    s.promo_id,
    s.amount_sold
  FROM sales s
  JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
  JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
  JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
  WHERE co.country_iso_code = 'US'
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
),

city_sales AS (
  SELECT city, calendar_quarter_id, SUM(amount_sold) AS total_sales
  FROM sales_us
  GROUP BY city, calendar_quarter_id
),

city_growth AS (
  SELECT 
    city,
    MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2019_q4,
    MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sales_2020_q4
  FROM city_sales
  GROUP BY city
  HAVING sales_2020_q4 >= 1.2 * sales_2019_q4
),

prod_city_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    su.prod_id,
    su.city,
    su.calendar_quarter_id,
    SUM(su.amount_sold) AS total_sales
  FROM sales_us su
  WHERE su.city IN (SELECT city FROM city_growth)
  GROUP BY su.prod_id, su.city, su.calendar_quarter_id
),

prod_qtr_sales AS (
  SELECT
    prod_id,
    calendar_quarter_id,
    SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales
  FROM prod_city_sales
  GROUP BY prod_id, calendar_quarter_id
),

all_prods_per_qtr AS (
  SELECT 
    calendar_quarter_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT prod_id) AS prod_count
  FROM prod_qtr_sales
  GROUP BY calendar_quarter_id
),

prod_sales_ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    pqs.prod_id,
    pqs.calendar_quarter_id,
    pqs.total_sales,
    apr.prod_count,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pqs.calendar_quarter_id ORDER BY pqs.total_sales DESC) AS rank
  FROM prod_qtr_sales pqs
  JOIN all_prods_per_qtr apr ON pqs.calendar_quarter_id = apr.calendar_quarter_id
),

prod_top_20_percent AS (
  SELECT 
    prod_id,
    calendar_quarter_id,
    total_sales
  FROM prod_sales_ranked
  WHERE rank <= CEIL(prod_count * 0.2)
),

total_sales_per_qtr AS (
  SELECT calendar_quarter_id, SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales_all
  FROM prod_top_20_percent
  GROUP BY calendar_quarter_id
),

prod_share AS (
  SELECT
    pt20.prod_id,
    pt20.calendar_quarter_id,
    pt20.total_sales,
    (pt20.total_sales * 1.0) / tspq.total_sales_all AS sales_share
  FROM prod_top_20_percent pt20
  JOIN total_sales_per_qtr tspq ON pt20.calendar_quarter_id = tspq.calendar_quarter_id
),

prod_share_change AS (
  SELECT 
    ps19.prod_id,
    ps19.sales_share AS share_2019_q4,
    COALESCE(ps20.sales_share, 0) AS share_2020_q4,
    ABS(COALESCE(ps20.sales_share, 0) - ps19.sales_share) AS share_change
  FROM prod_share ps19
  LEFT JOIN prod_share ps20 ON ps19.prod_id = ps20.prod_id AND ps20.calendar_quarter_id = 1776
  WHERE ps19.calendar_quarter_id = 1772
)

SELECT prod_id
FROM prod_share_change
ORDER BY share_change ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH customer_monthly_balance AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS year_month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_amount > 0 THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits,
        SUM(CASE WHEN txn_amount < 0 THEN txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawals,
        SUM(txn_amount) AS month_end_balance
    FROM customer_transactions
    WHERE strftime('%Y', txn_date) = '2020'
    GROUP BY customer_id, year_month
),

month_customer_counts AS (
    SELECT
        year_month,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS positive_balance_customer_count,
        AVG(month_end_balance) AS avg_balance_all_customers
    FROM customer_monthly_balance
    GROUP BY year_month
),

max_min_months AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT year_month FROM month_customer_counts ORDER BY positive_balance_customer_count DESC LIMIT 1) AS month_highest,
        (SELECT year_month FROM month_customer_counts ORDER BY positive_balance_customer_count ASC LIMIT 1) AS month_lowest
)

SELECT
    mh.month_highest AS month_with_highest_positive_customer_count,
    mmc_high.avg_balance_all_customers AS average_balance_in_highest_month,
    mh.month_lowest AS month_with_lowest_positive_customer_count,
    mmc_low.avg_balance_all_customers AS average_balance_in_lowest_month,
    mmc_high.avg_balance_all_customers - mmc_low.avg_balance_all_customers AS difference_between_averages
FROM max_min_months mh
JOIN month_customer_counts mmc_high ON mh.month_highest = mmc_high.year_month
JOIN month_customer_counts mmc_low ON mh.month_lowest = mmc_low.year_month;

WITH valid_orders AS (

pizza_prices AS (

filtered_orders AS (

extra_toppings_income AS (

runner_earnings AS (

WITH ItalianCustomers AS (

DecemberSalesProfits AS (

ItalianDecemberProfits AS (

RankedProfits AS (

WITH monthly_inserts AS (
  SELECT
    STRFTIME('%Y', inserted_at) AS year,
    STRFTIME('%m', inserted_at) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS cities_added
  FROM cities
  WHERE inserted_at >= '2021-04-01' AND inserted_at < '2023-07-01'
    AND month IN ('04', '05', '06')
  GROUP BY year, month
),
running_totals AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    month,
    cities_added,
    SUM(cities_added) OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY year ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total
  FROM monthly_inserts
),
growth_calc AS (
  SELECT
    current.year,
    current.month,
    current.cities_added,
    current.running_total,

    -- Monthly YoY Growth %
    CASE 
      WHEN prev_year.cities_added IS NOT NULL THEN 
        ROUND(100.0 * (current.cities_added - prev_year.cities_added) / prev_year.cities_added, 2)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS monthly_yoy_growth_pct,

    -- Running Total YoY Growth %
    CASE
      WHEN prev_year.running_total IS NOT NULL THEN
        ROUND(100.0 * (current.running_total - prev_year.running_total) / prev_year.running_total, 2)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS running_total_yoy_growth_pct

  FROM running_totals current
  LEFT JOIN running_totals prev_year
    ON current.month = prev_year.month
   AND CAST(current.year AS INTEGER) = CAST(prev_year.year AS INTEGER) + 1
)
SELECT
  year,
  month,
  cities_added,
  running_total,
  monthly_yoy_growth_pct,
  running_total_yoy_growth_pct
FROM growth_calc
WHERE year IN ('2022', '2023')
ORDER BY month, year;

WITH RankedDates AS (

),
GroupedDates AS (

  FROM RankedDates
),
ConsecutiveStreaks AS (

SELECT DISTINCT country_code

WITH base_orders AS (
  SELECT
    pco.row_id,
    pco.order_id,
    pco.customer_id,
    CASE WHEN pco.pizza_id = 1 THEN 'Meatlovers' ELSE 'Other' END AS pizza_name,

    pco.order_time
  FROM pizza_customer_orders pco
),
std_toppings AS (
  SELECT
    pr.pizza_id,
    tt.topping_name
  FROM pizza_recipes pr
  JOIN pizza_toppings tt ON pr.topping_id = tt.topping_id
),
excluded_toppings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    pge.row_id,
    pte.topping_name
  FROM pizza_get_exclusions pge
  JOIN pizza_toppings pte ON pge.topping_id = pte.topping_id
),
extra_toppings AS (
  SELECT 
    pge.row_id,
    pte.topping_name
  FROM pizza_get_extras pge
  JOIN pizza_toppings pte ON pge.topping_id = pte.topping_id
),
all_ingredients AS (
  SELECT
    bo.row_id,
    bo.order_id,
    bo.customer_id,
    bo.pizza_name,
    COALESCE(prst.topping_name, '') AS topping_name,
    'standard' AS source
  FROM base_orders bo
  LEFT JOIN std_toppings prst ON bo.pizza_id = prst.pizza_id
  WHERE bo.pizza_name IS NOT NULL
),
ingredients_excluded_removed AS (
  SELECT
    ai.row_id,
    ai.order_id,
    ai.customer_id,
    ai.pizza_name,
    ai.topping_name
  FROM all_ingredients ai
  LEFT JOIN excluded_toppings et ON ai.row_id = et.row_id AND ai.topping_name = et.topping_name
  WHERE et.topping_name IS NULL AND ai.topping_name != ''
),
ingredients_with_extra AS (
  SELECT
    ier.row_id,
    ier.order_id,
    ier.customer_id,
    ier.pizza_name,
    ier.topping_name
  FROM ingredients_excluded_removed ier
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    xe.row_id,
    xe.row_id AS order_id,
    NULL as customer_id,
    bo.pizza_name,
    xe.topping_name
  FROM extra_toppings xe
  JOIN base_orders bo ON xe.row_id = bo.row_id
),
ingredients_final AS (
  SELECT
    row_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    topping_name,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM ingredients_with_extra
  GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_name, topping_name
),
ingredients_ordered AS (
  SELECT
    row_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    CASE 
      WHEN cnt > 1 THEN '2x' || topping_name 
      ELSE topping_name 
    END AS topping_name_display,
    cnt
  FROM ingredients_final
),
ingredients_sorted AS (
  SELECT
    row_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    topping_name_display,
    cnt
  FROM ingredients_ordered
),
ingredients_agg AS (
  SELECT
    row_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_name,
    -- first list toppings with count>1 in alphabetical order, then single-count toppings alphabetically
    GROUP_CONCAT(topping_name_display, ', ') AS ingredients_str
  FROM (
    SELECT
      row_id,
      order_id,
      customer_id,
      pizza_name,
      topping_name_display,
      cnt
    FROM ingredients_sorted
    ORDER BY
      row_id,
      -- ordering by count desc (so 2x first) and alphabetically
      CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
      topping_name_display
  )
  GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_name
)
SELECT
  ia.row_id,
  ia.order_id,
  ia.customer_id,
  ia.pizza_name,
  ia.pizza_name || ': ' || ia.ingredients_str AS final_ingredients
FROM ingredients_agg ia
ORDER BY ia.row_id ASC
;

WITH RECURSIVE months(month_start) AS (
  SELECT date(min(txn_date), 'start of month')
  FROM customer_transactions
  UNION ALL
  SELECT date(month_start, '+1 month')
  FROM months
  WHERE month_start < (SELECT date(max(txn_date), 'start of month') FROM customer_transactions)
),

customer_months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, month_start
  FROM months CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions)
),

monthly_balances AS (
  SELECT
    cm.customer_id,
    cm.month_start,
    COALESCE(SUM(ct.txn_amount), 0) AS monthly_change
  FROM customer_months cm
  LEFT JOIN customer_transactions ct ON ct.customer_id = cm.customer_id
    AND date(ct.txn_date, 'start of month') = cm.month_start
  GROUP BY cm.customer_id, cm.month_start
),

cumulative_balances AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    month_start,
    monthly_change,
    SUM(monthly_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_balance
  FROM monthly_balances
)

SELECT customer_id, month_start AS month, monthly_change, cumulative_balance
FROM cumulative_balances
ORDER BY customer_id, month_start;

WITH filtered_events AS (
    SELECT
        sce.page_id,
        sce.product_id,
        sce.event_type
    FROM shopping_cart_events sce
    WHERE sce.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
),
views AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS view_count
    FROM filtered_events
    WHERE event_type = 'view'
    GROUP BY product_id
),
adds AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS add_count
    FROM filtered_events
    WHERE event_type = 'add'
    GROUP BY product_id
),
leaves AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS leave_count
    FROM filtered_events
    WHERE event_type = 'leave_without_purchase'
    GROUP BY product_id
),
purchases AS (
    SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS purchase_count
    FROM filtered_events
    WHERE event_type = 'purchase'
    GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(v.product_id, a.product_id, l.product_id, p.product_id) AS product_id,
    COALESCE(view_count, 0) AS view_count,
    COALESCE(add_count, 0) AS add_count,
    COALESCE(leave_count, 0) AS leave_count,
    COALESCE(purchase_count, 0) AS purchase_count
FROM views v
FULL OUTER JOIN adds a ON v.product_id = a.product_id
FULL OUTER JOIN leaves l ON COALESCE(v.product_id, a.product_id) = l.product_id
FULL OUTER JOIN purchases p ON COALESCE(v.product_id, a.product_id, l.product_id) = p.product_id
ORDER BY product_id;

WITH RankedInterests AS (
    SELECT
        TIME,

WITH CustomerOrderTotals AS (
    SELECT
        o.CustomerID,
        SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity) AS TotalSpent
    FROM
        orders o
        JOIN order_details od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID
    WHERE
        strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '1998'
    GROUP BY
        o.CustomerID
),
CustomerGroups AS (
    SELECT
        c.CustomerID,
        cct.CustomerGroup,
        cot.TotalSpent
    FROM
        CustomerOrderTotals cot
        JOIN customergroupthreshold cct ON cot.TotalSpent >= cct.Amount
    WHERE
        cct.Amount = (
            SELECT MAX(Amount)
            FROM customergroupthreshold
            WHERE Amount <= cot.TotalSpent
        )
),
GroupCounts AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerGroup,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS CustomerCount
    FROM
        CustomerGroups
    GROUP BY
        CustomerGroup
),
TotalCustomers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS TotalCustomerCount
    FROM CustomerOrderTotals
)
SELECT
    gc.CustomerGroup,
    gc.CustomerCount,
    ROUND(100.0 * gc.CustomerCount / tc.TotalCustomerCount, 2) AS PercentageOfTotal
FROM
    GroupCounts gc,
    TotalCustomers tc
ORDER BY
    gc.CustomerGroup;

WITH EmployeeOrderStats AS (
  SELECT

  FROM employees e
  JOIN orders o ON e.EmployeeID = o.EmployeeID
  GROUP BY e.EmployeeID
  HAVING COUNT(o.OrderID) > 50
)
SELECT
  EmployeeID,
  LateOrders,
  ROUND((LateOrders * 100.0) / TotalOrders, 2) AS LateOrderPercentage
FROM EmployeeOrderStats
ORDER BY LateOrderPercentage DESC
LIMIT 3;

MovieActorsGender AS (

MovieGenderSummary AS (

MovieExclusiveFemale AS (

Decades AS (

WITH ActorYears AS (

    WHERE m.year IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c.PID, m.year
),
YearGaps AS (

    FROM ActorYears
),
ActorsWithLongGap AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT

    WHERE next_year IS NOT NULL AND next_year - year > 3
),
ActorsActiveSpan AS (
    SELECT
        PID,
        MIN(year) AS first_year,
        MAX(year) AS last_year

)
SELECT COUNT(*)

WITH DirectorIDs AS (
  SELECT PID, ID FROM M_Director
),
YashChopra AS (
  SELECT PID FROM Person WHERE Name = 'Yash Chopra'
),
ActorDirectorFilmCounts AS (
  SELECT
    MC.PID as actor_PID,
    MD.PID as director_PID,
    COUNT(DISTINCT MC.MID) as films_together
  FROM M_Cast MC
  JOIN M_Director MD ON MC.MID = MD.MID
  GROUP BY MC.PID, MD.PID
),
MaxFilmCount AS (
  SELECT
    actor_PID,

  FROM ActorDirectorFilmCounts

),

WITH RegionSales AS (

        wr.region_name,
        COUNT(wsr.order_id) AS number_of_orders,

    JOIN web_region wr ON wsr.region_id = wr.region_id
    GROUP BY wsr.region_id, wr.region_name
),
SalesRepTotals AS (
    SELECT
        wsr.region_id,
        wsr.sales_rep_id,
        wrs.sales_rep_name,
        SUM(wsr.sales_amount) AS rep_total_sales
    FROM web_sales_reps wsr

    GROUP BY wsr.region_id, wsr.sales_rep_id, wrs.sales_rep_name
),
MaxRepSales AS (

),
TopSalesReps AS (

        srt.rep_total_sales
    FROM SalesRepTotals srt
    JOIN MaxRepSales mrs ON srt.region_id = mrs.region_id AND srt.rep_total_sales = mrs.max_sales

SELECT
    rs.region_name,

WITH English_Students AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    st.StudentID,
    st.StudLastName,
    ss.Grade
  FROM Students st
  JOIN Student_Schedules ss ON st.StudentID = ss.StudentID
  JOIN Classes c ON ss.ClassID = c.ClassID
  JOIN Subjects sub ON c.SubjectID = sub.SubjectID
  WHERE sub.SubjectName LIKE '%English%'
    AND ss.ClassStatus = 2
),
Ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    es.StudentID,
    es.StudLastName,
    es.Grade,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM English_Students es2 WHERE es2.Grade >= es.Grade) AS Rank
  FROM English_Students es
),
TotalCount AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS Total FROM English_Students
),
Quintiles AS (
  SELECT 
    r.StudLastName,
    r.Grade,
    r.Rank,
    t.Total,
    CASE 
      WHEN (r.Rank * 1.0 / t.Total) <= 0.2 THEN 'First'
      WHEN (r.Rank * 1.0 / t.Total) <= 0.4 THEN 'Second'
      WHEN (r.Rank * 1.0 / t.Total) <= 0.6 THEN 'Third'
      WHEN (r.Rank * 1.0 / t.Total) <= 0.8 THEN 'Fourth'
      ELSE 'Fifth'
    END AS Quintile
  FROM Ranked r
  CROSS JOIN TotalCount t
)
SELECT StudLastName AS LastName, Quintile
FROM Quintiles
ORDER BY CASE Quintile
  WHEN 'First' THEN 1
  WHEN 'Second' THEN 2
  WHEN 'Third' THEN 3
  WHEN 'Fourth' THEN 4
  WHEN 'Fifth' THEN 5
END

WITH

),
EntertainerTop2 AS (

),
CustomerTop3 AS (

),
CustomerTop2 AS (

WITH StyleScores AS (

AverageScore AS (

WITH SalesByPersonYear AS (
    SELECT
        soh.SalesPersonID,
        strftime('%Y', soh.OrderDate) AS SalesYear,
        SUM(sod.LineTotal) AS TotalSales
    FROM salesorderheader soh
    JOIN salesorderdetail sod ON soh.SalesOrderID = sod.SalesOrderID
    WHERE soh.SalesPersonID IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY soh.SalesPersonID, SalesYear
),
QuotaByPersonYear AS (
    SELECT
        SalesPersonID,
        strftime('%Y', YEAR) AS QuotaYear,
        SUM(SalesQuota) AS AnnualQuota
    FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory
    GROUP BY SalesPersonID, QuotaYear
)
SELECT
    sbp.SalesPersonID,
    sbp.SalesYear,
    COALESCE(sbp.TotalSales, 0) AS TotalSales,
    COALESCE(qbp.AnnualQuota, 0) AS AnnualQuota,
    COALESCE(sbp.TotalSales, 0) - COALESCE(qbp.AnnualQuota, 0) AS Difference
FROM SalesByPersonYear sbp
LEFT JOIN QuotaByPersonYear qbp ON sbp.SalesPersonID = qbp.SalesPersonID AND sbp.SalesYear = qbp.QuotaYear
ORDER BY sbp.SalesPersonID, sbp.SalesYear;

WITH DirectorMovies AS (
  SELECT
    dm.name_id AS director_id,
    n.name AS director_name,
    m.id AS movie_id,
    m.duration AS runtime,
    r.avg_rating AS rating,
    r.total_votes AS num_votes,
    m.year AS start_year
  FROM director_mapping dm
  JOIN names n ON dm.name_id = n.id
  JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
  LEFT JOIN ratings r ON m.id = r.movie_id
),

Aggregations AS (
  SELECT
    director_id,
    director_name,
    COUNT(movie_id) AS movie_count,
    ROUND(AVG(runtime)) AS avg_runtime,
    ROUND(AVG(rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
    SUM(num_votes) AS total_votes,
    MIN(rating) AS min_rating,
    MAX(rating) AS max_rating,
    SUM(runtime) AS total_runtime,
    MIN(start_year) AS min_year,
    MAX(start_year) AS max_year
  FROM DirectorMovies
  GROUP BY director_id, director_name
),

InterMovieDuration AS (
  SELECT
    director_id,
    CASE
      WHEN movie_count = 1 THEN 0
      ELSE ROUND(CAST(max_year - min_year AS FLOAT) / (movie_count - 1))
    END AS avg_inter_movie_duration
  FROM Aggregations
)

SELECT
  a.director_id,
  a.director_name,
  a.movie_count,
  COALESCE(imd.avg_inter_movie_duration, 0) AS avg_inter_movie_duration,
  COALESCE(a.avg_rating, 0) AS avg_rating,
  COALESCE(a.total_votes, 0) AS total_votes,
  COALESCE(a.min_rating, 0) AS min_rating,
  COALESCE(a.max_rating, 0) AS max_rating,
  COALESCE(a.total_runtime, 0) AS total_movie_duration
FROM Aggregations a
LEFT JOIN InterMovieDuration imd ON a.director_id = imd.director_id
ORDER BY a.movie_count DESC, a.total_runtime DESC
LIMIT 9;

WITH region_year_summaries AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    STRFTIME('%Y', created_at) AS year,
    SUM(transaction_dollar_amount) AS total_dollar_amount,
    SUM(transaction_btc_amount) AS total_btc_amount,
    MIN(STRFTIME('%Y', created_at)) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS first_year_per_region
  FROM bitcoin_transactions
  GROUP BY region, year
),
filtered_summaries AS (
  SELECT
    region,
    year,
    total_dollar_amount,
    total_btc_amount
  FROM region_year_summaries
  WHERE year > first_year_per_region
),
avg_price_per_year AS (
  SELECT
    region,
    year,
    total_dollar_amount / total_btc_amount AS avg_purchase_price
  FROM filtered_summaries
),
ranked_avg_price AS (
  SELECT
    region,
    year,
    avg_purchase_price,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY avg_purchase_price DESC) AS price_rank
  FROM avg_price_per_year
),
price_changes AS (
  SELECT
    cur.region,
    cur.year,
    cur.avg_purchase_price,
    cur.price_rank,
    CASE 
      WHEN prev.avg_purchase_price IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE 100.0 * (cur.avg_purchase_price - prev.avg_purchase_price) / prev.avg_purchase_price
    END AS annual_pct_change
  FROM ranked_avg_price cur
  LEFT JOIN ranked_avg_price prev
    ON cur.region = prev.region
    AND CAST(cur.year AS INTEGER) = CAST(prev.year AS INTEGER) + 1
)
SELECT *
FROM price_changes
ORDER BY year, price_rank;

WITH converted_volume AS (
    SELECT
        ticker,
        date,
        CASE
            WHEN volume = '-' THEN 0
            WHEN volume LIKE '%M' THEN CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'M', '') AS FLOAT) * 1000000
            WHEN volume LIKE '%K' THEN CAST(REPLACE(volume, 'K', '') AS FLOAT) * 1000
            ELSE CAST(volume AS FLOAT)
        END AS volume_num
    FROM bitcoin_prices
    WHERE date BETWEEN '2021-08-01' AND '2021-08-10'
),
filtered_volume AS (
    SELECT
        ticker,
        date,
        volume_num
    FROM converted_volume
),
prev_nonzero_volume AS (
    SELECT
        cv1.ticker,
        cv1.date,
        cv1.volume_num,
        (SELECT volume_num
         FROM filtered_volume cv2
         WHERE cv2.ticker = cv1.ticker
           AND cv2.date < cv1.date
           AND cv2.volume_num > 0
         ORDER BY cv2.date DESC
         LIMIT 1) AS prev_volume_num
    FROM filtered_volume cv1
),
daily_pct_change AS (
    SELECT
        ticker,
        date,
        volume_num,
        prev_volume_num,
        CASE
            WHEN prev_volume_num IS NULL OR prev_volume_num = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ((volume_num - prev_volume_num) / prev_volume_num) * 100
        END AS daily_volume_pct_change
    FROM prev_nonzero_volume
)
SELECT
    ticker,
    date,
    daily_volume_pct_change
FROM daily_pct_change
ORDER BY ticker, date;
