WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT
        legislator_id,
        MIN(start_date) AS first_term_start
    FROM legislators_terms
    WHERE start_date BETWEEN '1917-01-01' AND '1999-12-31'
    GROUP BY legislator_id
),
years AS (
    SELECT generate_series(1, 20) AS year_after_start
),
cohort_size AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM cohort
),
retention AS (
    SELECT
        y.year_after_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ct.legislator_id) AS retained_count
    FROM years y
    CROSS JOIN cohort ct
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON ct.legislator_id = lt.legislator_id
    WHERE DATE(lt.start_date) <= DATE(ct.first_term_start, '+' || y.year_after_start || ' years', '-1 day')
      AND DATE(lt.end_date) > DATE(ct.first_term_start, '+' || y.year_after_start || ' years', '-1 day')
    GROUP BY y.year_after_start
)
SELECT
    y.year_after_start,
    COALESCE(r.retained_count, 0) * 1.0 / cs.total AS retention_rate
FROM years y
LEFT JOIN retention r ON y.year_after_start = r.year_after_start
CROSS JOIN cohort_size cs
ORDER BY y.year_after_start;

WITH gender_terms AS (
  SELECT
    lt.state,
    l.gender,
    lt.term_start,
    lt.term_end,
    l.id_bioguide
  FROM legislators_terms lt
  JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
  WHERE lt.term_start IS NOT NULL AND lt.term_end IS NOT NULL
),

retention_years AS (
  SELECT 0 AS offset_year UNION ALL
  SELECT 2 UNION ALL
  SELECT 4 UNION ALL
  SELECT 6 UNION ALL
  SELECT 8 UNION ALL
  SELECT 10
),

retention_check AS (
  SELECT
    gt.state,
    gt.gender,
    ry.offset_year,
    gt.id_bioguide,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', gt.term_start) AS INTEGER) AS start_year,
    date((CAST(strftime('%Y', gt.term_start) AS INTEGER) + ry.offset_year) || '-12-31') AS check_date,
    gt.term_start,
    gt.term_end
  FROM gender_terms gt
  CROSS JOIN retention_years ry
),

retained AS (
  SELECT
    state,
    gender,
    offset_year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) AS retained_legislators
  FROM retention_check
  WHERE date(term_start) <= check_date AND date(term_end) >= check_date
  GROUP BY state, gender, offset_year
),

state_gender_retention AS (
  SELECT
    state,
    offset_year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN retained_legislators ELSE 0 END) AS male_retained,
    SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'F' THEN retained_legislators ELSE 0 END) AS female_retained
  FROM retained
  GROUP BY state, offset_year
),

valid_states AS (
  SELECT
    state
  FROM state_gender_retention
  WHERE male_retained > 0 AND female_retained > 0
  GROUP BY state
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT offset_year) = 6
)

SELECT state
FROM valid_states
ORDER BY state;

WITH Male_LA_Legislators AS (
    SELECT l.id_bioguide, l.gender
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE l.gender = 'M'
      AND lt.state = 'LA'
),
Eligible_Terms AS (
    SELECT lt.id_bioguide,
           MIN(DATE(lt.term_start)) AS first_term_start,
           DATE(lt.term_start) AS term_start,
           DATE(lt.term_end, '+1 day') AS term_end,
           lt.term_type
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN Male_LA_Legislators ml ON lt.id_bioguide = ml.id_bioguide
    GROUP BY lt.id_bioguide, lt.term_start, lt.term_end, lt.term_type
),
Years_Table AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        et.id_bioguide,
        et.first_term_start,
        CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', et.first_term_start) AS INTEGER) AS first_year,
        CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) AS current_year
    FROM Eligible_Terms et
),
Year_Range AS (
    SELECT Y.id_bioguide,
           Y.first_term_start,
           Y.first_year + num AS year,
           DATE(Y.first_term_start, '+' || num || ' years') AS date_on_year
    FROM Years_Table Y
    JOIN (
        SELECT 31 AS year UNION ALL SELECT 32 UNION ALL SELECT 33 UNION ALL SELECT 34 UNION ALL
        SELECT 35 UNION ALL SELECT 36 UNION ALL SELECT 37 UNION ALL SELECT 38 UNION ALL
        SELECT 39 UNION ALL SELECT 40 UNION ALL SELECT 41 UNION ALL SELECT 42 UNION ALL
        SELECT 43 UNION ALL SELECT 44 UNION ALL SELECT 45 UNION ALL SELECT 46 UNION ALL
        SELECT 47 UNION ALL SELECT 48 UNION ALL SELECT 49
    ) nums ON num BETWEEN 31 AND 49
),
Active_On_Dec_31 AS (
    SELECT YR.id_bioguide, YR.year, YR.date_on_year
    FROM Year_Range YR
    JOIN Eligible_Terms ET ON YR.id_bioguide = ET.id_bioguide
    WHERE DATE(YR.date_on_year || '-12-31') BETWEEN ET.term_start AND DATE(ET.term_end, '-1 day')
)
SELECT
    (year - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', first_term_start) AS INTEGER)) AS years_elapsed,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) AS distinct_legislators_count
FROM Active_On_Dec_31 AOD
JOIN Years_Table YT ON AOD.id_bioguide = YT.id_bioguide
GROUP BY years_elapsed
ORDER BY years_elapsed;

WITH customer_sales AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        MIN(rental_date) AS first_purchase,
        SUM(amount) AS lifetime_sales
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
), sales_within_periods AS (
    SELECT
        p.customer_id,
        cs.lifetime_sales,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.rental_date <= cs.first_purchase + INTERVAL 7 DAY THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_7_days,
        SUM(CASE WHEN p.rental_date <= cs.first_purchase + INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_30_days
    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer_sales cs ON p.customer_id = cs.customer_id
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, cs.lifetime_sales
)
SELECT
    AVG(lifetime_sales) AS avg_lifetime_sales,
    AVG(sales_7_days * 100.0 / lifetime_sales) AS avg_7_day_pct,
    AVG(sales_30_days * 100.0 / lifetime_sales) AS avg_30_day_pct
FROM sales_within_periods
WHERE lifetime_sales > 0;

WITH ActorFilmRevenue AS (
    SELECT
        fa.actor_id,
        fa.film_id,
        (SUM(p.amount) / COUNT(fa.actor_id)) AS revenue_per_actor
    FROM
        film_actor fa
        JOIN inventory i ON fa.film_id = i.film_id
        JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
        JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
    GROUP BY
        fa.actor_id, fa.film_id
),
RankedFilms AS (
    SELECT
        actor_id,
        film_id,
        revenue_per_actor,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id ORDER BY revenue_per_actor DESC) AS rank
    FROM ActorFilmRevenue
),
ActorAverageRevenue AS (
    SELECT
        actor_id,
        AVG(revenue_per_actor) AS avg_revenue_per_actor
    FROM RankedFilms
    WHERE rank <= 3
    GROUP BY actor_id
)
SELECT
    a.actor_id,
    a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name AS actor_name,
    rf.film_id,
    f.title AS film_title,
    rf.revenue_per_actor,
    aar.avg_revenue_per_actor
FROM
    RankedFilms rf
    JOIN actor a ON rf.actor_id = a.actor_id
    JOIN film f ON rf.film_id = f.film_id
    JOIN ActorAverageRevenue aar ON rf.actor_id = aar.actor_id
WHERE
    rf.rank <= 3
ORDER BY
    a.actor_id,
    rf.rank;

WITH ActorRentalCounts AS (
  SELECT fa.actor_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.customer_id) AS customer_rent_count
  FROM film_actor fa
  JOIN inventory i ON fa.film_id = i.film_id
  JOIN rental r ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  GROUP BY fa.actor_id
), TopFiveActors AS (
  SELECT actor_id
  FROM ActorRentalCounts
  ORDER BY customer_rent_count DESC
  LIMIT 5
), CustomersWhoRentedTopActors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.customer_id
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  JOIN film_actor fa ON i.film_id = fa.film_id
  WHERE fa.actor_id IN (SELECT actor_id FROM TopFiveActors)
), TotalCustomers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS total_customers
  FROM customer
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(
    100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CustomersWhoRentedTopActors) / (SELECT total_customers FROM TotalCustomers),
    2
  ) AS percentage_customers_rented_top_5_actors_films
;

WITH FirstRental AS (
  SELECT
    p.customer_id,
    p.payment_date,
    f.rating
  FROM payment p
  JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id
  WHERE (p.customer_id, p.payment_date) IN (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(payment_date)
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
  )
), 
CustomerRentals AS (
  SELECT
    r.customer_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_rentals
  FROM rental r
  GROUP BY r.customer_id
),
JoinedData AS (
  SELECT
    fr.rating,
    fr.customer_id,
    SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount,
    (cr.total_rentals - 1) AS subsequent_rentals
  FROM FirstRental fr
  JOIN payment p ON fr.customer_id = p.customer_id
  JOIN CustomerRentals cr ON fr.customer_id = cr.customer_id
  GROUP BY fr.customer_id, fr.rating, cr.total_rentals
)
SELECT
  rating,
  AVG(total_amount) AS avg_total_amount_per_customer,
  AVG(subsequent_rentals) AS avg_subsequent_rentals_per_customer
FROM JoinedData
GROUP BY rating
ORDER BY rating;

WITH Top10Customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY customer_id
  ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
MonthlyPayments AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', payment_date) AS payment_month,
    SUM(amount) AS total_amount
  FROM payment
  WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM Top10Customers)
  GROUP BY customer_id, payment_month
),
MonthlyDifferences AS (
  SELECT 
    mp1.customer_id,
    mp1.payment_month,
    ROUND(ABS(mp2.total_amount - mp1.total_amount), 2) AS month_over_month_diff
  FROM MonthlyPayments mp1
  JOIN MonthlyPayments mp2 ON mp1.customer_id = mp2.customer_id
    AND mp2.payment_month = strftime('%Y-%m', date(mp1.payment_month || '-01', '+1 month'))
)
SELECT 
  customer_id,
  payment_month,
  month_over_month_diff
FROM MonthlyDifferences
ORDER BY month_over_month_diff DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH country_sales AS (
    SELECT c.Country, SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS total_sales
    FROM customers c
    JOIN invoices i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    JOIN invoice_items ii ON i.InvoiceId = ii.InvoiceId
    GROUP BY c.Country
),
country_customer_counts AS (
    SELECT Country, COUNT(CustomerId) AS customer_count
    FROM customers
    GROUP BY Country
),
sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT cs.total_sales
    FROM country_sales cs
    JOIN country_customer_counts ccc ON cs.Country = ccc.Country
    WHERE ccc.customer_count > 4
),
median_calc AS (
    SELECT total_sales, 
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales) AS row_num, 
           COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
    FROM sales_filtered
)
SELECT AVG(total_sales) AS median_sales
FROM median_calc
WHERE row_num IN ((total_count + 1) / 2, (total_count + 2) / 2);

WITH rentals_by_store_year_month AS (
  SELECT
    i.store_id,
    STRFTIME('%Y', r.rental_date) AS rental_year,
    STRFTIME('%m', r.rental_date) AS rental_month,
    COUNT(*) AS total_rentals
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  JOIN staff s ON r.staff_id = s.staff_id
  WHERE s.store_id = i.store_id
  GROUP BY i.store_id, rental_year, rental_month
),
max_rentals AS (
  SELECT
    store_id,
    MAX(total_rentals) AS max_total_rentals
  FROM rentals_by_store_year_month
  GROUP BY store_id
)
SELECT
  r.store_id,
  r.rental_year AS year,
  r.rental_month AS month,
  r.total_rentals
FROM rentals_by_store_year_month r
JOIN max_rentals m ON r.store_id = m.store_id AND r.total_rentals = m.max_total_rentals
ORDER BY r.store_id;

WITH filtered_words AS (
  SELECT words AS word
  FROM word_list
  WHERE LENGTH(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5 AND words LIKE 'r%'
), characters AS (
  SELECT word, SUBSTR(word, n, 1) AS ch
  FROM filtered_words, (SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5) AS numbers
  WHERE n <= LENGTH(word)
),
word_letters AS (
  SELECT word, ch
  FROM characters
  ORDER BY word, ch
),
signatures AS (
  SELECT word, GROUP_CONCAT(ch, '') AS signature
  FROM word_letters
  GROUP BY word
),
anagram_counts AS (
  SELECT s1.word, COUNT(*) AS anagram_count
  FROM signatures s1
  JOIN signatures s2 ON s1.signature = s2.signature AND s1.word != s2.word
  GROUP BY s1.word
)
SELECT word, anagram_count
FROM anagram_counts
ORDER BY word
LIMIT 10;

WITH state_alien_stats AS (
    SELECT
        state,
        COUNT(*) AS total_aliens,
        SUM(CASE WHEN aggressive = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS friendly_aliens,
        SUM(CASE WHEN aggressive = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hostile_aliens,
        AVG(age) AS avg_age
    FROM alien_data
    GROUP BY state
),
ranked_states AS (
    SELECT
        state,
        total_aliens,
        friendly_aliens,
        hostile_aliens,
        avg_age,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_aliens DESC) AS rank
    FROM state_alien_stats
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS count_top_10_states
FROM ranked_states
WHERE rank <= 10
  AND friendly_aliens > hostile_aliens
  AND avg_age > 200
;

WITH StoreOrderCounts AS (
    SELECT
        s.store_id,
        s.store_name,
        COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders
    FROM orders o
    JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
    GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name
    ORDER BY total_orders DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
StoreDeliveredOrders AS (
    SELECT
        o.store_id,
        COUNT(d.delivery_order_id) AS delivered_orders
    FROM orders o
    JOIN deliveries d ON o.order_id = d.delivery_order_id
    WHERE d.delivery_status = 'DELIVERED'
      AND o.store_id = (SELECT store_id FROM StoreOrderCounts)
    GROUP BY o.store_id
)
SELECT
    soc.store_name,
    soc.total_orders,
    COALESCE(sdo.delivered_orders, 0) AS delivered_orders,
    ROUND(COALESCE(sdo.delivered_orders, 0) * 1.0 / soc.total_orders, 4) AS delivered_ratio
FROM StoreOrderCounts soc
LEFT JOIN StoreDeliveredOrders sdo ON soc.store_id = sdo.store_id
;

WITH monthly_orders AS (
    SELECT
        hubs.hub_id,
        hubs.hub_name,
        strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_moment_finished) AS order_month,
        COUNT(orders.order_id) AS finished_order_count
    FROM hubs
    LEFT JOIN orders ON hubs.hub_id = orders.delivery_order_id AND orders.order_status = 'finished'
    WHERE order_month IN ('2023-02', '2023-03')
    GROUP BY hubs.hub_id, order_month
),
order_comparison AS (
    SELECT
        f.hub_id,
        f.hub_name,
        f.finished_order_count AS feb_finished_orders,
        m.finished_order_count AS mar_finished_orders,
        CASE
            WHEN f.finished_order_count = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (m.finished_order_count * 1.0 / f.finished_order_count) - 1
        END AS growth_rate
    FROM monthly_orders f
    LEFT JOIN monthly_orders m ON f.hub_id = m.hub_id AND m.order_month = '2023-03'
    WHERE f.order_month = '2023-02'
)
SELECT hub_id, hub_name, feb_finished_orders, mar_finished_orders, growth_rate
FROM order_comparison
WHERE growth_rate > 0.2;

WITH daily_deliveries AS (
  SELECT
    driver_id,
    delivery_date,
    COUNT(*) AS deliveries_per_day
  FROM deliveries
  GROUP BY driver_id, delivery_date
),
avg_daily_deliveries AS (
  SELECT
    driver_id,
    AVG(deliveries_per_day) AS avg_deliveries
  FROM daily_deliveries
  GROUP BY driver_id
)
SELECT driver_id, avg_deliveries
FROM avg_daily_deliveries
ORDER BY avg_deliveries DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH TeamSeasonGoals AS (
  SELECT
    t.id AS team_id,
    m.season,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id THEN m.home_team_goal ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id THEN m.away_team_goal ELSE 0 END) AS goals
  FROM Team t
  JOIN Match m ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id OR t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
  GROUP BY t.id, m.season
),
HighestSeasonGoals AS (
  SELECT team_id, MAX(goals) AS max_goals
  FROM TeamSeasonGoals
  GROUP BY team_id
),
OrderedGoals AS (
  SELECT max_goals, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_goals) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
  FROM HighestSeasonGoals
)
SELECT AVG(max_goals*1.0) AS median_goals
FROM OrderedGoals
WHERE rn IN ((cnt + 1)/2, (cnt + 2)/2)

WITH Team_Wins AS (
  SELECT
    L.id AS league_id,
    T.team_api_id,
    T.team_long_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id AND M.home_team_goal > M.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) +
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id AND M.away_team_goal > M.home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_wins
  FROM Team T
  CROSS JOIN League L
  LEFT JOIN Match M ON (M.league_id = L.id AND (M.home_team_api_id = T.team_api_id OR M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id))
  GROUP BY L.id, T.team_api_id
),
League_Min_Wins AS (
  SELECT league_id, MIN(total_wins) AS min_wins
  FROM Team_Wins
  GROUP BY league_id
),
League_Fewest_Wins AS (
  SELECT tw.league_id, tw.team_api_id, tw.team_long_name, tw.total_wins
  FROM Team_Wins tw
  JOIN League_Min_Wins lmw ON tw.league_id = lmw.league_id AND tw.total_wins = lmw.min_wins
  GROUP BY tw.league_id
)
SELECT league_id, team_api_id, team_long_name, total_wins
FROM League_Fewest_Wins;

WITH Player_Match_Results AS (
  SELECT
    pa.player_api_id,
    m.match_api_id,
    pa.team_api_id,
    CASE
      WHEN pa.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id AND m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 'win'
      WHEN pa.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 'win'
      WHEN pa.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id AND m.home_team_goal < m.away_team_goal THEN 'loss'
      WHEN pa.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id AND m.away_team_goal < m.home_team_goal THEN 'loss'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS result
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
  JOIN Match m ON m.match_api_id = pa.match_api_id
  WHERE pa.player_api_id IS NOT NULL
),
Player_Win_Loss_Counts AS (
  SELECT
    player_api_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS win_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_count
  FROM Player_Match_Results
  WHERE result IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY player_api_id
),
Most_Wins AS (
  SELECT 'Most Wins Player' AS category, player_api_id, win_count AS count
  FROM Player_Win_Loss_Counts
  ORDER BY win_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
Most_Losses AS (
  SELECT 'Most Losses Player' AS category, player_api_id, loss_count AS count
  FROM Player_Win_Loss_Counts
  ORDER BY loss_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT * FROM Most_Wins
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM Most_Losses;

WITH TeamWins AS (
  SELECT
    Winner AS team_id,
    COUNT(*) AS wins
  FROM
    Match
  WHERE
    Winner IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    Winner
)
SELECT
  t.team_long_name,
  tw.wins
FROM
  TeamWins tw
JOIN
  Team t ON tw.team_id = t.team_api_id
ORDER BY
  tw.wins DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH
-- Calculate total runs per batsman per season
batsman_runs AS (
  SELECT
    m.season_id,
    p.player_id,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs
  FROM batsman_scored bs
  JOIN player_match pm ON bs.match_id = pm.match_id AND bs.batsman_id = pm.player_id
  JOIN match m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id
  JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
  GROUP BY m.season_id, p.player_id
),
-- Rank batsmen by total_runs desc, player_id asc per season and pick top 3
top_batsmen AS (
  SELECT
    season_id,
    player_id,
    total_runs,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC, player_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM batsman_runs
  WHERE total_runs > 0
),
-- Filter top 3 batsmen per season
top3_batsmen AS (
  SELECT season_id, player_id, total_runs, rn
  FROM top_batsmen
  WHERE rn <= 3
),
-- Calculate total wickets per bowler per season excluding specified dismissal kinds
bowler_wickets AS (
  SELECT
    m.season_id,
    wt.player_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_wickets
  FROM wicket_taken wt
  JOIN match m ON wt.match_id = m.match_id
  WHERE wt.dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'hit wicket', 'retired hurt')
  GROUP BY m.season_id, wt.player_id
),
-- Rank bowlers by total_wickets desc, player_id asc per season and pick top 3
top_bowlers AS (
  SELECT
    season_id,
    player_id,
    total_wickets,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season_id ORDER BY total_wickets DESC, player_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM bowler_wickets
  WHERE total_wickets > 0
),
-- Filter top 3 bowlers per season
top3_bowlers AS (
  SELECT season_id, player_id, total_wickets, rn
  FROM top_bowlers
  WHERE rn <= 3
)
-- Final output joining top 3 batsmen and top 3 bowlers by same rank and season
SELECT
  b.season_id,
  b.rn AS position,
  b.player_id AS batsman_id,
  b.total_runs,
  bw.player_id AS bowler_id,
  bw.total_wickets
FROM top3_batsmen b
JOIN top3_bowlers bw ON b.season_id = bw.season_id AND b.rn = bw.rn
ORDER BY b.season_id, b.rn;

WITH partnership_runs AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        batsman1_id,
        batsman2_id,
        SUM(runs) AS partnership_score,
        SUM(CASE WHEN striker_id = batsman1_id THEN runs ELSE 0 END) AS batsman1_score,
        SUM(CASE WHEN striker_id = batsman2_id THEN runs ELSE 0 END) AS batsman2_score
    FROM ball_by_ball
    GROUP BY match_id, batsman1_id, batsman2_id
),
ranked_partnerships AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        batsman1_id,
        batsman2_id,
        batsman1_score,
        batsman2_score,
        partnership_score,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY partnership_score DESC) AS partnership_rank
    FROM partnership_runs
),
final_partnerships AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        CASE
            WHEN batsman1_score > batsman2_score THEN batsman1_id
            WHEN batsman1_score < batsman2_score THEN batsman2_id
            WHEN batsman1_score = batsman2_score AND batsman1_id > batsman2_id THEN batsman1_id
            ELSE batsman2_id
        END AS player1_id,
        CASE
            WHEN batsman1_score > batsman2_score THEN batsman2_id
            WHEN batsman1_score < batsman2_score THEN batsman1_id
            WHEN batsman1_score = batsman2_score AND batsman1_id > batsman2_id THEN batsman2_id
            ELSE batsman1_id
        END AS player2_id,
        CASE
            WHEN batsman1_score > batsman2_score THEN batsman1_score
            WHEN batsman1_score < batsman2_score THEN batsman2_score
            WHEN batsman1_score = batsman2_score AND batsman1_id > batsman2_id THEN batsman1_score
            ELSE batsman2_score
        END AS player1_score,
        CASE
            WHEN batsman1_score > batsman2_score THEN batsman2_score
            WHEN batsman1_score < batsman2_score THEN batsman1_score
            WHEN batsman1_score = batsman2_score AND batsman1_id > batsman2_id THEN batsman2_score
            ELSE batsman1_score
        END AS player2_score,
        partnership_score
    FROM ranked_partnerships
    WHERE partnership_rank = 1
)
SELECT player1_id, player2_id, player1_score, player2_score, partnership_score
FROM final_partnerships
ORDER BY match_id, player1_id, player2_id;

WITH TrackDuration AS (
    SELECT 
        TrackId, 
        Milliseconds / 60000.0 AS DurationMin
    FROM Track
),
Stats AS (
    SELECT 
        MIN(DurationMin) AS MinDuration,
        AVG(DurationMin) AS AvgDuration,
        MAX(DurationMin) AS MaxDuration
    FROM TrackDuration
),
Categories AS (
    SELECT 
        t.TrackId,
        t.DurationMin,
        CASE
            WHEN t.DurationMin <= (s.MinDuration + s.AvgDuration) / 2 THEN 'Short'
            WHEN t.DurationMin <= (s.AvgDuration + s.MaxDuration) / 2 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Long'
        END AS DurationCategory
    FROM TrackDuration t, Stats s
),
InvoiceData AS (
    SELECT 
        il.TrackId,
        SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS Revenue
    FROM InvoiceLine il
    GROUP BY il.TrackId
),
CategoryRevenue AS (
    SELECT
        c.DurationCategory,
        MIN(c.DurationMin) AS MinDuration,
        MAX(c.DurationMin) AS MaxDuration,
        SUM(COALESCE(i.Revenue,0)) AS TotalRevenue
    FROM Categories c
    LEFT JOIN InvoiceData i ON c.TrackId = i.TrackId
    GROUP BY c.DurationCategory
)
SELECT DurationCategory, MinDuration, MaxDuration, TotalRevenue
FROM CategoryRevenue
ORDER BY DurationCategory;

WITH CleanedSalaries AS (
  SELECT
    Location,
    CompanyName,
    CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(Salary, '[^0-9]', '') AS INTEGER) AS Numeric_Salary
  FROM SalaryDataset
  WHERE Salary IS NOT NULL AND Salary != ''
),
AvgSalariesByCity AS (
  SELECT
    Location,
    CompanyName,
    AVG(Numeric_Salary) AS Avg_Salary_By_City
  FROM CleanedSalaries
  WHERE Location IN ('Mumbai', 'Pune', 'New Delhi', 'Hyderabad')
  GROUP BY Location, CompanyName
),
Top5Companies AS (
  SELECT
    Location,
    CompanyName,
    Avg_Salary_By_City,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY Location ORDER BY Avg_Salary_By_City DESC) AS RankByCity
  FROM AvgSalariesByCity
),
AvgSalaryCountry AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(Numeric_Salary) AS Avg_Salary_Country
  FROM CleanedSalaries
)
SELECT
  t.Location AS Location,
  t.CompanyName AS "Company Name",
  t.Avg_Salary_By_City AS "Average Salary in State",
  ac.Avg_Salary_Country AS "Average Salary in Country"
FROM Top5Companies t
CROSS JOIN AvgSalaryCountry ac
WHERE t.RankByCity <= 5
ORDER BY t.Location, t.Avg_Salary_By_City DESC;

WITH bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, COUNT(*) AS wickets
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.match_id = bb.match_id AND wt.over_id = bb.over_id AND wt.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND wt.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    WHERE kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt')
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowler_ball_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bowler,
        COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) AS runs_off_bat
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY bowler
),
bowler_stats AS (
    SELECT
        bw.bowler,
        bw.wickets,
        bbr.balls_bowled,
        bbr.runs_off_bat,
        CASE WHEN bbr.balls_bowled > 0 THEN (CAST(bbr.runs_off_bat AS FLOAT) / (bbr.balls_bowled / 6.0)) ELSE NULL END AS economy_rate,
        CASE WHEN bw.wickets > 0 THEN (CAST(bbr.balls_bowled AS FLOAT) / bw.wickets) ELSE NULL END AS strike_rate
    FROM bowler_wickets bw
    JOIN bowler_ball_runs bbr ON bw.bowler = bbr.bowler
),
bowler_match_performance AS (
    SELECT
        bb.bowler,
        wt.match_id,
        COUNT(*) AS wickets_in_match,
        SUM(COALESCE(bs.runs_scored, 0)) AS runs_conceded_in_match
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.match_id = bb.match_id AND wt.over_id = bb.over_id AND wt.ball_id = bb.ball_id AND wt.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE kind_out NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt')
    GROUP BY bb.bowler, wt.match_id
),
bowler_best_performance AS (
    SELECT
        bowler,
        match_id,
        wickets_in_match,
        runs_conceded_in_match,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bowler ORDER BY wickets_in_match DESC, runs_conceded_in_match ASC) AS rn
    FROM bowler_match_performance
)

SELECT
    bs.bowler,
    bs.wickets,
    ROUND(bs.economy_rate, 2) AS economy_rate,
    ROUND(bs.strike_rate, 2) AS strike_rate,
    (CAST(bbp.wickets_in_match AS TEXT) || '-' || CAST(bbp.runs_conceded_in_match AS TEXT)) AS best_bowling_performance
FROM bowler_stats bs
JOIN bowler_best_performance bbp ON bs.bowler = bbp.bowler AND bbp.rn = 1
ORDER BY bs.bowler
LIMIT 1000;

WITH player_runs AS (
  SELECT
    pm.player_id,
    SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pm.match_id) AS matches_played,
    SUM(CASE WHEN w.wicket_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissals,
    MAX(bs.runs_scored) AS highest_score,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bs.runs_scored >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_30_plus,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bs.runs_scored >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_50_plus,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bs.runs_scored >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_100_plus,
    SUM(bs.balls_faced) AS balls_faced
  FROM player_match pm
  LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON pm.player_id = bs.player_id AND pm.match_id = bs.match_id
  LEFT JOIN wicket_taken w ON pm.player_id = w.player_out_id AND pm.match_id = w.match_id
  GROUP BY pm.player_id
),
player_bowling AS (
  SELECT
    pt.player_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(bt.wicket_id IS NOT NULL), 0) AS total_wickets,
    SUM(bb.balls_bowled) AS balls_bowled,
    SUM(bb.runs_given) AS runs_given,
    COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(bb.runs_given) * 6.0 / NULLIF(SUM(bb.balls_bowled), 0), 2), 0) AS economy_rate
  FROM player_match pt
  LEFT JOIN wicket_taken bt ON pt.player_id = bt.player_id AND pt.match_id = bt.match_id
  LEFT JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON pt.player_id = bb.bowler_id AND pt.match_id = bb.match_id
  GROUP BY pt.player_id
),
best_bowling_performance AS (
  SELECT
    bowler_id AS player_id,
    MAX(wickets) AS max_wickets
  FROM (
    SELECT
      bowler_id,
      match_id,
      COUNT(wicket_id) AS wickets,
      SUM(runs_given) AS runs_given
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.player_id = bb.bowler_id AND wt.match_id = bb.match_id AND wt.over = bb.over AND wt.ball = bb.ball
    GROUP BY bowler_id, match_id
  )
  GROUP BY bowler_id
),
best_bowling_detail AS (
  SELECT
    bowler_id AS player_id,
    match_id,
    wickets,
    runs_given
  FROM (
    SELECT
      bowler_id,
      match_id,
      COUNT(wicket_id) AS wickets,
      SUM(runs_given) AS runs_given,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY bowler_id
        ORDER BY COUNT(wicket_id) DESC, SUM(runs_given) ASC
      ) AS rk
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.player_id = bb.bowler_id AND wt.match_id = bb.match_id AND wt.over = bb.over AND wt.ball = bb.ball
    GROUP BY bowler_id, match_id
  )
  WHERE rk = 1
),
player_role AS (
  SELECT
    player_id,
    role,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
  FROM player_match
  GROUP BY player_id, role
),
most_frequent_role AS (
  SELECT player_id, role FROM player_role WHERE rn = 1
)

SELECT
  p.player_id,
  p.player_name,
  mfr.role AS most_frequent_role,
  p.batting_hand,
  p.bowling_skill,
  pr.total_runs,
  pr.matches_played,
  pr.dismissals,
  CASE WHEN pr.dismissals > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(pr.total_runs AS FLOAT) / pr.dismissals, 2) ELSE NULL END AS batting_average,
  pr.highest_score,
  pr.matches_30_plus,
  pr.matches_50_plus,
  pr.matches_100_plus,
  pr.balls_faced,
  CASE WHEN pr.balls_faced > 0 THEN ROUND(CAST(pr.total_runs AS FLOAT) / pr.balls_faced * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END AS strike_rate,
  pb.total_wickets,
  pb.economy_rate,
  CASE
    WHEN bbp.wickets IS NOT NULL
    THEN bbp.wickets || '-' || bbp.runs_given
    ELSE NULL
  END AS best_bowling_performance
FROM player p
LEFT JOIN player_runs pr ON p.player_id = pr.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_bowling pb ON p.player_id = pb.player_id
LEFT JOIN best_bowling_detail bbp ON p.player_id = bbp.player_id
LEFT JOIN most_frequent_role mfr ON p.player_id = mfr.player_id
ORDER BY p.player_id;

WITH StackMax AS (
  SELECT ms.name AS problem_name, ms.step, MAX(ms.test_score) AS max_stack_score
  FROM model_score ms
  JOIN model m ON ms.name = m.name AND ms.version = m.version AND ms.step = m.step
  WHERE m.L1_model = 'Stack'
    AND ms.step IN (1, 2, 3)
  GROUP BY ms.name, ms.step
),
NonStackMax AS (
  SELECT ms.name AS problem_name, ms.step, MAX(ms.test_score) AS max_non_stack_score
  FROM model_score ms
  JOIN model m ON ms.name = m.name AND ms.version = m.version AND ms.step = m.step
  WHERE m.L1_model != 'Stack'
    AND ms.step IN (1, 2, 3)
  GROUP BY ms.name, ms.step
),
StepsWhereStackBetter AS (
  SELECT s.problem_name, s.step
  FROM StackMax s
  LEFT JOIN NonStackMax n
  ON s.problem_name = n.problem_name AND s.step = n.step
  WHERE s.max_stack_score > IFNULL(n.max_non_stack_score, -1)
),
SolutionProblemCount AS (
  SELECT name, COUNT(*) AS sol_count
  FROM solution
  GROUP BY name
),
SolutionStepsProblem AS (
  SELECT s.name, ms.step
  FROM solution s
  JOIN model_score ms ON s.name = ms.name
  WHERE ms.step IN (1, 2, 3)
),
ProblemsStepCount AS (
  SELECT name, COUNT(step) AS step_count
  FROM SolutionStepsProblem
  WHERE (name, step) IN (SELECT problem_name, step FROM StepsWhereStackBetter)
  GROUP BY name
),
ProblemAppearances AS (
  SELECT name, COUNT(*) AS total_appearances
  FROM solution
  GROUP BY name
)

SELECT p.name
FROM ProblemsStepCount p
JOIN SolutionProblemCount spc ON p.name = spc.name
WHERE spc.sol_count > (SELECT total_appearances FROM ProblemAppearances WHERE name = p.name)
;

WITH model_steps AS (
  SELECT
    m.name AS model_name,
    m.version AS model_version,
    ms.step,
    ms.l1_model,
    ms.is_stack,
    ms.test_score
  FROM model m
  JOIN model_score ms ON m.id = ms.model_id
),
step_max_scores AS (
  SELECT
    model_name,
    model_version,
    step,
    MAX(CASE WHEN is_stack = 0 THEN test_score ELSE NULL END) AS max_non_stack_score,
    MAX(CASE WHEN is_stack = 1 THEN test_score ELSE NULL END) AS stack_score
  FROM model_steps
  GROUP BY model_name, model_version, step
),
model_status AS (
  SELECT
    model_name,
    model_version,
    CASE 
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM step_max_scores AS s2
        WHERE s2.model_name = s1.model_name
          AND s2.model_version = s1.model_version
          AND s2.max_non_stack_score < s2.stack_score
      ) THEN 'strong'
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM step_max_scores AS s2
        WHERE s2.model_name = s1.model_name
          AND s2.model_version = s1.model_version
          AND s2.max_non_stack_score = s2.stack_score
      ) THEN 'soft'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS status
  FROM step_max_scores s1
  GROUP BY model_name, model_version
),
model_l1_status AS (
  SELECT
    ms.model_name,
    ms.model_version,
    ms.l1_model,
    ms.is_stack,
    ms.test_score,
    mstatus.status
  FROM model_steps ms
  JOIN model_status mstatus ON ms.model_name = mstatus.model_name AND ms.model_version = mstatus.model_version
  WHERE mstatus.status IS NOT NULL
),
l1_model_status_counts AS (
  SELECT
    status,
    l1_model,
    COUNT(*) AS occurrence
  FROM model_l1_status
  GROUP BY status, l1_model
),
max_occurrences AS (
  SELECT
    status,
    MAX(occurrence) AS max_occurrence
  FROM l1_model_status_counts
  GROUP BY status
)
SELECT
  l.status,
  l.l1_model,
  l.occurrence
FROM l1_model_status_counts l
JOIN max_occurrences m ON l.status = m.status AND l.occurrence = m.max_occurrence
ORDER BY l.status;

WITH model_counts AS (
    SELECT L1_model, COUNT(*) AS count
    FROM model
    GROUP BY L1_model
),
category_group AS (
    SELECT L1_model, 
           CASE 
               WHEN L1_model LIKE '%Stack%' THEN 'Stack'
               ELSE 'Traditional'
           END AS model_type,
           count AS total_count
    FROM model_counts
)
SELECT model_type, L1_model, total_count
FROM category_group
WHERE (model_type, total_count) IN (
    SELECT model_type, MAX(total_count)
    FROM category_group
    GROUP BY model_type
);

WITH RECURSIVE
ExpandedPackaging AS (
  SELECT
    packaging_id AS final_packaging_id,
    contains_id AS child_packaging_id,
    qty AS child_qty
  FROM packaging_relations
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    ep.final_packaging_id,
    pr.contains_id,
    ep.child_qty * pr.qty
  FROM packaging_relations pr
  JOIN ExpandedPackaging ep ON pr.packaging_id = ep.child_packaging_id
),
LeafPackaging AS (
  SELECT
    ep.final_packaging_id,
    ep.child_packaging_id,
    ep.child_qty
  FROM ExpandedPackaging ep
  LEFT JOIN packaging_relations pr ON ep.child_packaging_id = pr.packaging_id
  WHERE pr.packaging_id IS NULL
),
AggregatedQuantities AS (
  SELECT
    final_packaging_id,
    SUM(child_qty) AS total_quantity
  FROM LeafPackaging
  GROUP BY final_packaging_id
)
SELECT AVG(total_quantity) AS average_total_quantity
FROM AggregatedQuantities;

WITH RECURSIVE
  -- Recursive CTE to find all nested packaging and accumulate quantities from bottom to top
  nested_packaging(parent_packaging_id, child_packaging_id, quantity) AS (
    SELECT packaging_id AS parent_packaging_id, child_packaging_id, quantity
    FROM packaging_relations
    UNION ALL
    SELECT np.parent_packaging_id, pr.child_packaging_id, pr.quantity * np.quantity
    FROM nested_packaging np
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON np.child_packaging_id = pr.parent_packaging_id
  ),

  -- Aggregate total quantity per top-level packaging and item
  item_quantities AS (
    SELECT
      p_top.packaging_id AS top_packaging_id,
      p_top.name AS top_packaging_name,
      pr.item_id,
      SUM(COALESCE(np.quantity, 1)) AS total_quantity -- multiply quantities down the chain. Use 1 for direct packaging.
    FROM packaging p_top
    LEFT JOIN nested_packaging np ON p_top.packaging_id = np.parent_packaging_id
    LEFT JOIN packaging_relations pr ON np.child_packaging_id = pr.parent_packaging_id
    OR (p_top.packaging_id = pr.parent_packaging_id AND np.child_packaging_id IS NULL)
    JOIN inventory i ON pr.item_id = i.item_id
    WHERE p_top.packaging_id NOT IN (SELECT child_packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
    GROUP BY p_top.packaging_id, p_top.name, pr.item_id
  )

SELECT
  ipq.top_packaging_name AS packaging_container_name,
  it.name AS item_name
FROM item_quantities ipq
JOIN products it ON ipq.item_id = it.product_id
WHERE ipq.total_quantity > 500
ORDER BY ipq.top_packaging_name, it.name;

WITH order_lines AS (
  SELECT ol.id AS line_id, ol.product_id, ol.qty AS quantity
  FROM orderlines ol
  WHERE ol.order_id = 423
  ORDER BY ol.id
),

inventory_ordered AS (
  SELECT i.product_id, i.location_id, i.qty AS available_quantity, l.aisle, l.position, p.purchased
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN locations l ON i.location_id = l.id
  JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
  WHERE l.warehouse = 1
  AND i.qty > 0
  ORDER BY i.product_id, p.purchased ASC, i.qty ASC
),

pick_plan AS (
  SELECT ol.line_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity AS order_quantity, io.location_id, io.aisle, io.position, io.available_quantity,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ol.product_id ORDER BY ol.line_id) AS order_line_seq,
         SUM(ol.quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY ol.product_id ORDER BY ol.line_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_order_qty
  FROM order_lines ol
  LEFT JOIN inventory_ordered io ON ol.product_id = io.product_id
),

pick_final AS (
  SELECT pa.line_id, pa.product_id, pa.location_id, pa.aisle, pa.position,
         CASE
           WHEN pa.available_quantity > 0 THEN 
             CASE
               WHEN pa.cumulative_order_qty - COALESCE(LAG(pa.cumulative_order_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY pa.product_id ORDER BY pa.line_id), 0) > pa.available_quantity THEN pa.available_quantity
               ELSE pa.cumulative_order_qty - COALESCE(LAG(pa.cumulative_order_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY pa.product_id ORDER BY pa.line_id), 0)
             END
           ELSE 0
         END AS quantity_to_pick
  FROM pick_plan pa
  WHERE pa.available_quantity > 0
)

SELECT line_id, product_id, aisle, position, SUM(quantity_to_pick) AS quantity_to_pick
FROM pick_final
WHERE quantity_to_pick > 0
GROUP BY line_id, product_id, aisle, position
ORDER BY line_id, product_id, aisle, position
;

WITH inventory_with_purchase AS (
  SELECT
    i.product_id,
    i.location_id,
    i.qty AS quantity_available,
    p.purchased AS purchase_date
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
),

inventory_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    location_id,
    quantity_available,
    purchase_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY purchase_date ASC, quantity_available ASC) AS fifo_rank
  FROM inventory_with_purchase
),

order_inventory_pick AS (
  SELECT
    ol.product_id,
    ol.order_id,
    ol.qty AS order_quantity,
    ir.location_id,
    ir.quantity_available,
    ir.fifo_rank,
    CASE
      WHEN ol.qty < ir.quantity_available THEN ol.qty
      ELSE ir.quantity_available
    END AS pick_quantity
  FROM orderlines ol
  JOIN inventory_ranked ir ON ol.product_id = ir.product_id
),

product_picks AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    SUM(pick_quantity) AS total_picked_quantity,
    SUM(order_quantity) AS total_order_quantity
  FROM order_inventory_pick
  GROUP BY product_id
)

SELECT
  pr.name AS product_name,
  CASE WHEN pp.total_order_quantity = 0 THEN 0
       ELSE CAST(pp.total_picked_quantity AS FLOAT) / pp.total_order_quantity
  END AS average_pick_percentage
FROM product_picks pp
JOIN products pr ON pp.product_id = pr.id
ORDER BY pr.name;

WITH fifo_order_picks AS (
    SELECT
        pl.product_id,
        pl.qty AS picked_qty,
        plst.created AS pick_created
    FROM picking_line pl
    JOIN picking_list plst ON pl.picklist_id = plst.id
    WHERE pl.order_id = 421
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    AVG(picked_qty) AS avg_units_picked
FROM fifo_order_picks
GROUP BY product_id
ORDER BY product_id;

WITH sales_data AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y-%m', o.ordered) AS year_month,
        p.id AS productid,
        SUM(ol.amount) AS monthly_sales
    FROM
        orders o
    JOIN orderlines ol ON o.id = ol.order_id
    JOIN products p ON ol.product_id = p.id
    WHERE
        o.ordered >= '2016-01-01' AND o.ordered < '2018-01-01'
    GROUP BY
        year_month, p.id
), numbered_months AS (
    SELECT
        year_month,
        productid,
        monthly_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY productid ORDER BY year_month) AS month_index
    FROM sales_data
), cma_calc AS (
    SELECT
        a.year_month,
        a.productid,
        a.monthly_sales,
        AVG(b.monthly_sales) AS window1_avg,
        AVG(c.monthly_sales) AS window2_avg
    FROM numbered_months a
    LEFT JOIN numbered_months b ON a.productid = b.productid AND b.month_index BETWEEN a.month_index - 5 AND a.month_index + 6
    LEFT JOIN numbered_months c ON a.productid = c.productid AND c.month_index BETWEEN a.month_index - 6 AND a.month_index + 5
    WHERE a.month_index BETWEEN 7 AND 30
    GROUP BY a.productid, a.year_month, a.monthly_sales, a.month_index
), cma_final AS (
    SELECT
        year_month,
        productid,
        monthly_sales,
        (window1_avg + window2_avg) / 2.0 AS cma
    FROM cma_calc
), ratio_calc AS (
    SELECT
        year_month,
        productid,
        monthly_sales / cma AS sales_to_cma_ratio
    FROM cma_final
    WHERE cma > 0
), filtered_2017 AS (
    SELECT * FROM ratio_calc
    WHERE year_month LIKE '2017%'
)
SELECT productid
FROM filtered_2017
GROUP BY productid
HAVING MIN(sales_to_cma_ratio) > 2;

WITH month_indices AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT mth FROM monthly_sales
  WHERE mth >= '2016-01-01'
  ORDER BY mth
),
numbered_months AS (
  SELECT mth, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mth) AS month_index
  FROM month_indices
),

sales_data AS (
  SELECT
    ms.product_id,
    nm.month_index,
    ms.qty AS sales_amount
  FROM monthly_sales ms
  JOIN numbered_months nm ON ms.mth = nm.mth
  WHERE ms.product_id IN (4160, 7790)
    AND nm.month_index BETWEEN 1 AND 36
),

-- Calculate centered moving average (CMA) using 12-month overlapping windows for each product
cma_calc AS (
  SELECT
    s1.product_id,
    s1.month_index,
    (
      (SELECT AVG(sales_amount) FROM sales_data s2
       WHERE s2.product_id = s1.product_id
         AND s2.month_index BETWEEN s1.month_index - 6 AND s1.month_index + 5) +
      (SELECT AVG(sales_amount) FROM sales_data s3
       WHERE s3.product_id = s1.product_id
         AND s3.month_index BETWEEN s1.month_index - 5 AND s1.month_index + 6)
    ) / 2.0 AS cma_value
  FROM sales_data s1
  WHERE s1.month_index BETWEEN 7 AND 30
),

-- Join sales and CMA to get sales-to-CMA ratio
sales_cma_ratio AS (
  SELECT
    sd.product_id,
    sd.month_index,
    sd.sales_amount,
    c.cma_value,
    (CAST(sd.sales_amount AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(c.cma_value, 0)) AS sales_to_cma_ratio
  FROM sales_data sd
  JOIN cma_calc c
    ON sd.product_id = c.product_id
   AND sd.month_index = c.month_index
  WHERE sd.month_index BETWEEN 7 AND 30
),

-- Using weighted regression method to forecast sales for 2018 (months 25 to 36 are 2018 months in the 3-year span)
weights AS (
  SELECT
    month_index,
    CASE WHEN month_index BETWEEN 7 AND 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS weight
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT month_index FROM sales_data)
),

weighted_sums AS (
  SELECT
    sd.product_id,
    SUM(sd.month_index * w.weight) AS sum_xw,
    SUM(sd.sales_amount * w.weight) AS sum_yw,
    SUM(sd.month_index * sd.sales_amount * w.weight) AS sum_xyw,
    SUM(sd.month_index * sd.month_index * w.weight) AS sum_x2w,
    SUM(w.weight) AS sum_w
  FROM sales_data sd
  JOIN weights w ON sd.month_index = w.month_index
  GROUP BY sd.product_id
),

regression_params AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    (sum_w * sum_xyw - sum_xw * sum_yw) * 1.0 / NULLIF((sum_w * sum_x2w - sum_xw * sum_xw), 0) AS slope,
    (sum_yw - (sum_w * sum_xyw - sum_xw * sum_yw) * 1.0 / NULLIF((sum_w * sum_x2w - sum_xw * sum_xw), 0) * sum_xw) * 1.0 / NULLIF(sum_w, 0) AS intercept
  FROM weighted_sums
),

forecast_2018 AS (
  SELECT
    rp.product_id,
    m.month_index,
    (rp.intercept + rp.slope * m.month_index) AS forecasted_sales
  FROM regression_params rp
  JOIN (SELECT 25 AS month_index UNION SELECT 26 UNION SELECT 27 UNION SELECT 28 UNION SELECT 29 UNION SELECT 30 UNION SELECT 31 UNION SELECT 32 UNION SELECT 33 UNION SELECT 34 UNION SELECT 35 UNION SELECT 36) m
),

avg_forecast_annual_sales AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    AVG(forecasted_sales) AS avg_annual_sales
  FROM forecast_2018
  GROUP BY product_id
)

SELECT product_id, avg_annual_sales
FROM avg_forecast_annual_sales
ORDER BY product_id;

WITH
-- Extract starting inventory as sum of qty in inventory for Dec 2018 per product
starting_inventory AS (
    SELECT i.product_id, SUM(i.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM inventory i
    JOIN purchases p ON i.purchase_id = p.id
    WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', p.purchased) = '2018-12'
    GROUP BY i.product_id
),

-- Minimum inventory per product
minimum_inventory AS (
    SELECT product_id, qty_minimum
    FROM product_minimums
),

-- Aggregate monthly purchases in 2019 per product
monthly_purchases AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           CAST(strftime('%m', purchased) AS INTEGER) AS month,
           SUM(qty) AS purchase_qty
    FROM purchases
    WHERE strftime('%Y', purchased) = '2019'
    GROUP BY product_id, month
),

-- Recursive inventory calculation month by month for 2019
inventory_2019 AS (
    -- Anchor: month = 1 (January 2019)
    SELECT 
        si.product_id,
        2019 AS year,
        1 AS month,
        CASE WHEN si.total_qty < pm.qty_minimum THEN pm.qty_minimum ELSE si.total_qty END AS start_inventory,
        CASE WHEN si.total_qty < pm.qty_minimum THEN pm.qty_minimum + COALESCE(mp.purchase_qty, 0) ELSE si.total_qty + COALESCE(mp.purchase_qty, 0) END AS end_inventory,
        pm.qty_minimum
    FROM starting_inventory si
    JOIN minimum_inventory pm ON si.product_id = pm.product_id
    LEFT JOIN monthly_purchases mp ON si.product_id = mp.product_id AND mp.month = 1

    UNION ALL

    -- Recursive step for months 2 to 12
    SELECT
        inv.product_id,
        2019 AS year,
        inv.month + 1 AS month,
        CASE WHEN inv.end_inventory < inv.qty_minimum THEN inv.qty_minimum ELSE inv.end_inventory END AS start_inventory,
        CASE WHEN inv.end_inventory < inv.qty_minimum THEN inv.qty_minimum + COALESCE(mp.purchase_qty, 0) ELSE inv.end_inventory + COALESCE(mp.purchase_qty, 0) END AS end_inventory,
        inv.qty_minimum
    FROM inventory_2019 inv
    LEFT JOIN monthly_purchases mp ON inv.product_id = mp.product_id AND mp.month = inv.month + 1
    WHERE inv.month < 12
)

SELECT product_id, month,
       ABS(end_inventory - qty_minimum) AS abs_difference
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, month, end_inventory, qty_minimum,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY ABS(end_inventory - qty_minimum)) AS rnk
    FROM inventory_2019
)
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY product_id;

WITH MatchResults AS (
  SELECT
    league_id,
    season,
    home_team_api_id AS team_id,
    CASE
      WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 3
      WHEN home_team_goal = away_team_goal THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS points
  FROM Match
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    league_id,
    season,
    away_team_api_id AS team_id,
    CASE
      WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 3
      WHEN away_team_goal = home_team_goal THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS points
  FROM Match
),

TeamPoints AS (
  SELECT
    league_id,
    season,
    team_id,
    SUM(points) AS total_points
  FROM MatchResults
  GROUP BY league_id, season, team_id
),

MaxPointsPerSeason AS (
  SELECT
    league_id,
    season,
    MAX(total_points) AS max_points
  FROM TeamPoints
  GROUP BY league_id, season
),

ChampionTeams AS (
  SELECT
    tp.league_id,
    tp.season,
    tp.team_id,
    tp.total_points
  FROM TeamPoints tp
  JOIN MaxPointsPerSeason mps ON tp.league_id = mps.league_id AND tp.season = mps.season AND tp.total_points = mps.max_points
),

ChampionDetails AS (
  SELECT
    ct.season,
    t.team_long_name AS champion_team_name,
    l.name AS league_name,
    c.name AS country_name,
    ct.total_points
  FROM ChampionTeams ct
  JOIN Team t ON ct.team_id = t.team_api_id
  JOIN League l ON ct.league_id = l.id
  JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
)

SELECT * FROM ChampionDetails
ORDER BY season, country_name, league_name, champion_team_name
;

WITH stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(loss_rate) AS avg_loss_rate,
        STDDEV(loss_rate) AS stddev_loss_rate
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df
),
categorized AS (
    SELECT
        loss_rate,
        CASE
            WHEN loss_rate < avg_loss_rate - stddev_loss_rate THEN 'below'
            WHEN loss_rate > avg_loss_rate + stddev_loss_rate THEN 'above'
            ELSE 'within'
        END AS category
    FROM veg_loss_rate_df, stats
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_loss_rate FROM stats) AS average_loss_rate,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN category = 'below' THEN 1 END) AS below_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN category = 'within' THEN 1 END) AS within_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN category = 'above' THEN 1 END) AS above_count
FROM categorized;

WITH yearly_category_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    strftime('%Y', date) AS year,
    category,
    ROUND(AVG(wholesale_price), 2) AS avg_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MAX(wholesale_price), 2) AS max_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MIN(wholesale_price), 2) AS min_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MAX(wholesale_price) - MIN(wholesale_price), 2) AS wholesale_price_diff,
    ROUND(SUM(wholesale_price), 2) AS total_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(SUM(selling_price), 2) AS total_selling_price,
    ROUND(AVG(loss_rate), 2) AS avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(SUM(loss_amount), 2) AS total_loss,
    ROUND(SUM(selling_price) - SUM(wholesale_price) - SUM(loss_amount), 2) AS profit
  FROM veg_whsle_df
  WHERE year BETWEEN '2020' AND '2023'
  GROUP BY year, category
)
SELECT * FROM yearly_category_stats
ORDER BY year, category;

WITH SellerSales AS (
    SELECT
        s.seller_id,
        s.seller_zip_code_prefix,
        p.product_category_name,
        pcn.product_category_name_english,
        SUM(oi.order_item_id) AS total_items_sold,
        SUM(oi.price * oi.order_item_id) AS total_sales,
        AVG(oi.price) AS avg_item_price,
        AVG(orv.review_score) AS avg_review_score,
        AVG(julianday(o.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(o.order_approved_at)) AS avg_packing_time_days
    FROM sellers s
    JOIN order_items oi ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN product_category_name_translation pcn ON p.product_category_name = pcn.product_category_name
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    LEFT JOIN order_reviews orv ON o.order_id = orv.order_id
    WHERE oi.order_item_id > 0
    GROUP BY s.seller_id, p.product_category_name, pcn.product_category_name_english
    HAVING SUM(oi.order_item_id) > 100
),
CategoryMaxSales AS (
    SELECT
        seller_id,
        MAX(total_items_sold) AS max_sales
    FROM SellerSales
    GROUP BY seller_id
)
SELECT
    ss.seller_id,
    ss.seller_zip_code_prefix,
    ss.total_sales,
    ss.avg_item_price,
    ss.avg_review_score,
    ss.avg_packing_time_days,
    ss.product_category_name_english AS highest_sales_category
FROM SellerSales ss
JOIN CategoryMaxSales cms ON ss.seller_id = cms.seller_id AND ss.total_items_sold = cms.max_sales
ORDER BY ss.seller_id;

WITH monthly_net AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    STRFTIME('%Y-%m-01', txn_date) AS month_start,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS net_amount
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, month_start
),
closing_balance AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    month_start,
    SUM(net_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS closing_balance
  FROM monthly_net
),
latest_growth AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    month_start,
    closing_balance,
    LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) AS prev_balance,
    CASE 
      WHEN LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) = 0 OR LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start) IS NULL
        THEN closing_balance * 100
      ELSE
        (closing_balance - LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start)) * 100.0 / LAG(closing_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start)
    END AS growth_rate
  FROM closing_balance
),
most_recent_month AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    growth_rate
  FROM (
    SELECT customer_id, growth_rate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start DESC) AS rank
    FROM latest_growth
  )
  WHERE rank = 1
)
SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS pct_customers_growth_above_5
FROM most_recent_month;

WITH monthly_balances AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', created_at) AS month,
    SUM(CASE WHEN balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE balance END) AS total_balance
  FROM bitcoin_members
  GROUP BY month
),
monthly_ordered AS (
  SELECT
    month,
    total_balance,
    LAG(total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_balance
  FROM monthly_balances
)
SELECT
  month,
  COALESCE(prev_month_balance, 0) AS total_balance_previous_month
FROM monthly_ordered
WHERE prev_month_balance IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY month;

WITH cus_txn AS (
  -- Calculate daily net transaction values (deposits add, others subtract) per customer
  SELECT customer_id, DATE(txn_date) AS txn_date,
    SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS net_amount
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
cus_running_balance AS (
  -- Calculate running daily balance per customer
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date,
    SUM(net_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_balance
  FROM cus_txn
),
cus_rolling_avg AS (
  -- Calculate rolling 30-day average balance per customer (treat negative averages as zero)
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) = 30 THEN 
      MAX(0, AVG(running_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW))
    ELSE NULL
    END AS rolling_avg_30d
  FROM cus_running_balance
),
cus_monthly_max AS (
  -- Get month and max 30-day rolling average balance per customer per month
  SELECT customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS month,
    MAX(rolling_avg_30d) AS max_rolling_avg_30d
  FROM cus_rolling_avg
  WHERE rolling_avg_30d IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
cus_first_month AS (
  -- Identify first month of transaction history per customer
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(strftime('%Y-%m', txn_date)) AS first_month
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
monthly_sums_excluding_baseline AS (
  -- Exclude baseline month and sum max 30-day averages across customers by month
  SELECT m.month, SUM(m.max_rolling_avg_30d) AS sum_max_rolling_avg_30d
  FROM cus_monthly_max m
  JOIN cus_first_month f ON m.customer_id = f.customer_id
  WHERE m.month > f.first_month
  GROUP BY m.month
  ORDER BY m.month
)
SELECT * FROM monthly_sums_excluding_baseline;

WITH customer_date_range AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    MIN(txn_date) AS min_date,
    MAX(txn_date) AS max_date
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
),

all_dates AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT txn_date FROM customer_transactions
),

calendar AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    txn_date
  FROM customer_date_range
  JOIN all_dates ON txn_date BETWEEN min_date AND max_date
),

txn_per_day AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    txn_date,
    COALESCE(SUM(txn_amount), 0) AS daily_amount
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),

balances_unadjusted AS (
  SELECT 
    c.customer_id, c.txn_date,
    COALESCE(t.daily_amount, 0) AS daily_amount
  FROM calendar c
  LEFT JOIN txn_per_day t ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id AND c.txn_date = t.txn_date
  ORDER BY c.customer_id, c.txn_date
),

balances_with_carryforward AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id, txn_date,
    MAX(
      SUM(daily_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY txn_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
    , 0) AS daily_balance
  FROM balances_unadjusted
),

monthly_max_balances AS (
  SELECT 
    customer_id,
    STRFTIME('%Y-%m', txn_date) AS year_month,
    MAX(daily_balance) AS max_daily_balance
  FROM balances_with_carryforward
  GROUP BY customer_id, year_month
),

monthly_total AS (
  SELECT 
    year_month,
    SUM(max_daily_balance) AS total_monthly_max_balance
  FROM monthly_max_balances
  GROUP BY year_month
)

SELECT * FROM monthly_total
ORDER BY year_month;

WITH sales_with_year_week AS (
  SELECT
    year,
    week,
    sales_amount
  FROM weekly_sales
  WHERE year IN (2018, 2019, 2020)
),
date_reference AS (
  -- June 15 week number roughly around week 24 of each year (varies slightly by year, but we use 24 as approximate midpoint)
  SELECT DISTINCT year, 24 AS mid_week FROM sales_with_year_week
),
weekly_sales_lag_lead AS (
  SELECT
    s.year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.week BETWEEN d.mid_week - 4 AND d.mid_week - 1 THEN s.sales_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.week BETWEEN d.mid_week AND d.mid_week + 3 THEN s.sales_amount ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after
  FROM sales_with_year_week s
  JOIN date_reference d ON s.year = d.year
  GROUP BY s.year
)
SELECT
  year,
  sales_before,
  sales_after,
  ROUND((CAST(sales_after AS FLOAT) - sales_before) / NULLIF(sales_before, 0) * 100, 2) AS pct_change
FROM weekly_sales_lag_lead
ORDER BY year;

WITH baseline_end_date AS (
  SELECT DATE('2020-06-15') AS ref_date
),

periods AS (
  SELECT
    date(ref_date, '-84 day') AS period_start,
    date(ref_date, '-1 day') AS period_end,
    'before' AS period
  FROM baseline_end_date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    date(ref_date, '+1 day') AS period_start,
    date(ref_date, '+84 day') AS period_end,
    'after' AS period
  FROM baseline_end_date
),

-- Calculate total sales per attribute type and attribute value during the periods
sales_by_attribute AS (
  SELECT
    'region' AS attribute_type,
    region AS attribute_value,
    p.period,
    SUM(sales) AS total_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales ws
  JOIN periods p ON ws.week_date BETWEEN p.period_start AND p.period_end
  GROUP BY region, p.period

  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT
    'platform' AS attribute_type,
    platform AS attribute_value,
    p.period,
    SUM(sales) AS total_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales ws
  JOIN periods p ON ws.week_date BETWEEN p.period_start AND p.period_end
  GROUP BY platform, p.period

  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT
    'age band' AS attribute_type,
    age_band AS attribute_value,
    p.period,
    SUM(sales) AS total_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales ws
  JOIN periods p ON ws.week_date BETWEEN p.period_start AND p.period_end
  GROUP BY age_band, p.period

  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT
    'demographic' AS attribute_type,
    demographic AS attribute_value,
    p.period,
    SUM(sales) AS total_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales ws
  JOIN periods p ON ws.week_date BETWEEN p.period_start AND p.period_end
  GROUP BY demographic, p.period

  UNION ALL
  
  SELECT
    'customer type' AS attribute_type,
    customer_type AS attribute_value,
    p.period,
    SUM(sales) AS total_sales
  FROM cleaned_weekly_sales ws
  JOIN periods p ON ws.week_date BETWEEN p.period_start AND p.period_end
  GROUP BY customer_type, p.period
),

-- Calculate percentage change for each attribute value
pct_change_by_attr_val AS (
  SELECT
    attribute_type,
    attribute_value,
    (MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'after' THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END) - MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'before' THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
    NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'before' THEN total_sales ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pct_change
  FROM sales_by_attribute
  GROUP BY attribute_type, attribute_value
),

-- Calculate average percentage change by attribute type
avg_pct_change_by_attr_type AS (
  SELECT
    attribute_type,
    AVG(pct_change) AS avg_pct_change
  FROM pct_change_by_attr_val
  GROUP BY attribute_type
),

-- Identify attribute type with the largest negative impact (smallest avg pct change)
worst_impact AS (
  SELECT
    attribute_type,
    avg_pct_change
  FROM avg_pct_change_by_attr_type
  ORDER BY avg_pct_change ASC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
  (SELECT attribute_type FROM worst_impact) AS attribute_type_with_highest_negative_impact,
  (SELECT avg_pct_change FROM worst_impact) AS average_percentage_change_in_sales
;

WITH driver_points_per_year AS (
  SELECT
    d.year,

), top_drivers AS (

    dp.year,

  tc.total_points AS constructor_points

WITH YearlyDriverPoints AS (
  SELECT year, driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points
  FROM results
  GROUP BY year, driverId
),
MaxDriverPoints AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(total_points) AS max_driver_points
  FROM YearlyDriverPoints
  GROUP BY year
),
YearlyConstructorPoints AS (
  SELECT year, constructorId, SUM(points) AS total_points
  FROM results
  GROUP BY year, constructorId
),
MaxConstructorPoints AS (
  SELECT year, MAX(total_points) AS max_constructor_points
  FROM YearlyConstructorPoints
  GROUP BY year
),
YearlyMaxPointsSum AS (
  SELECT 
    d.year,
    d.max_driver_points + c.max_constructor_points AS total_max_points
  FROM MaxDriverPoints d
  JOIN MaxConstructorPoints c ON d.year = c.year
)
SELECT year
FROM YearlyMaxPointsSum

WITH driver_points AS (
  SELECT
    ds.driverId,
    ds.season,
    ds.constructorId,
    MAX(ds.points) AS max_points_per_driver
  FROM driver_standings ds
  GROUP BY ds.driverId, ds.season, ds.constructorId
),
constructor_points AS (
  SELECT
    cs.constructorId,
    cs.season,
    cs.points AS constructor_points
  FROM constructor_standings cs
),
combined_points AS (
  SELECT
    d.season,
    d.constructorId,
    c.name AS constructor_name,
    d.driverId,
    d.max_points_per_driver,
    cst.constructor_points,
    d.max_points_per_driver + cst.constructor_points AS total_points
  FROM driver_points d
  JOIN constructor_points cst
    ON d.constructorId = cst.constructorId AND d.season = cst.season
  JOIN constructors c
    ON d.constructorId = c.constructorId
),
ranked_points AS (
  SELECT
    season,
    constructorId,
    constructor_name,
    total_points,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY season ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS rank_in_season
  FROM combined_points
)
SELECT
  constructor_name,
  season,
  total_points
FROM (
  SELECT
    constructor_name,
    season,
    total_points,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS rank_overall
  FROM ranked_points
  WHERE rank_in_season = 1
)
WHERE rank_overall <= 3
ORDER BY rank_overall;

WITH ordered_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    session,
    action AS page_url,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp) AS rn
  FROM access_log
  WHERE action IN ('/regist/input', '/regist/confirm')
),
session_sequences AS (
  SELECT
    s1.session
  FROM ordered_sessions s1
  JOIN ordered_sessions s2 ON s1.session = s2.session
    AND s1.rn + 1 = s2.rn
  WHERE s1.page_url = '/regist/input'
    AND s2.page_url = '/regist/confirm'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session) AS unique_sessions_count
FROM session_sequences;

WITH first_last_per_session AS (
  SELECT
    session,
    MIN(stamp) AS landing_ts,
    MAX(stamp) AS exit_ts
  FROM activity_log
  GROUP BY session
),
landing_pages AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    a.session,
    a.path AS web_page
  FROM activity_log a
  JOIN first_last_per_session s
    ON a.session = s.session AND a.stamp = s.landing_ts
),
exit_pages AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    a.session,
    a.path AS web_page
  FROM activity_log a
  JOIN first_last_per_session s
    ON a.session = s.session AND a.stamp = s.exit_ts
),
combined_pages AS (
  SELECT * FROM landing_pages
  UNION
  SELECT * FROM exit_pages
)
SELECT
  web_page,
  COUNT(DISTINCT session) AS unique_sessions
FROM combined_pages
GROUP BY web_page
ORDER BY unique_sessions DESC;

WITH ranked_visits AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    action AS page_action,
    stamp AS visit_time,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY stamp) AS rn
  FROM access_log
),
three_step_sequences AS (
  SELECT
    a.user_id,
    a.page_action AS first_page,
    b.page_action AS second_page,
    c.page_action AS third_page
  FROM ranked_visits a
  JOIN ranked_visits b ON a.user_id = b.user_id AND b.rn = a.rn + 1
  JOIN ranked_visits c ON a.user_id = c.user_id AND c.rn = b.rn + 1
  WHERE a.page_action = '/detail' AND b.page_action = '/detail'
)
SELECT
  third_page,
  COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count
FROM three_step_sequences
GROUP BY third_page
ORDER BY occurrence_count DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH season_driver_points AS (
  SELECT 
    ra.year AS season,
    r.driver_id,
    r.constructor_id,
    SUM(r.points) AS total_points
  FROM results r
  JOIN races ra ON r.race_id = ra.race_id
  WHERE ra.year >= 2001
  GROUP BY ra.year, r.driver_id, r.constructor_id
  HAVING total_points > 0
),
season_min_points AS (
  SELECT 
    season,
    MIN(total_points) AS min_points
  FROM season_driver_points
  GROUP BY season
),
season_driver_min AS (
  SELECT sdp.season, sdp.driver_id, sdp.constructor_id, sdp.total_points
  FROM season_driver_points sdp
  JOIN season_min_points smp ON sdp.season = smp.season AND sdp.total_points = smp.min_points
),
season_min_constructor AS (
  SELECT 
    season,
    constructor_id
  FROM season_driver_min
  GROUP BY season, constructor_id
),
constructor_min_seasons_count AS (
  SELECT 
    constructor_id,
    COUNT(season) AS min_seasons_count
  FROM season_min_constructor
  GROUP BY constructor_id
)
SELECT c.name AS constructor_name, cmsc.min_seasons_count
FROM constructor_min_seasons_count cmsc
JOIN constructors c ON cmsc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY cmsc.min_seasons_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH first_five_laps AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT race_id, lap
  FROM lap_times
  WHERE lap <= 5
),
retired_drivers AS (
  SELECT race_id, driver_id, lap AS retirement_lap
  FROM retirements
),
pit_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT race_id, driver_id, lap
  FROM pit_stops
),
start_grid_positions AS (
  SELECT race_id, driver_id, grid
  FROM results
  WHERE grid > 0
),
overtakes AS (
  SELECT 
    curr.race_id,
    curr.lap,
    prev.driver_id AS overtaken_driver_id,
    curr.driver_id AS overtaking_driver_id,
    curr.position AS overtaking_position,
    prev.position AS overtaken_position
  FROM lap_positions curr
  JOIN lap_positions prev ON curr.race_id = prev.race_id
    AND curr.lap = prev.lap + 1
    AND curr.position = prev.position - 1
    AND curr.driver_id != prev.driver_id
    AND curr.race_id IN (SELECT race_id FROM first_five_laps)
),
overtake_labels AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    CASE
      WHEN r.retirement_lap = o.lap THEN 'R'
      WHEN p_current.lap = o.lap OR p_prev.lap = o.lap - 1 THEN 'P'
      WHEN o.lap = 1 
           AND s1.grid IS NOT NULL AND s2.grid IS NOT NULL
           AND ABS(s1.grid - s2.grid) <= 2 THEN 'S'
      ELSE 'T'
    END AS category
  FROM overtakes o
  LEFT JOIN retired_drivers r ON o.race_id = r.race_id AND o.overtaken_driver_id = r.driver_id 
  LEFT JOIN pit_events p_current ON o.race_id = p_current.race_id AND o.overtaken_driver_id = p_current.driver_id AND o.lap = p_current.lap
  LEFT JOIN pit_events p_prev ON o.race_id = p_prev.race_id AND o.overtaken_driver_id = p_prev.driver_id AND o.lap - 1 = p_prev.lap
  LEFT JOIN start_grid_positions s1 ON o.race_id = s1.race_id AND o.overtaking_driver_id = s1.driver_id
  LEFT JOIN start_grid_positions s2 ON o.race_id = s2.race_id AND o.overtaken_driver_id = s2.driver_id
)
SELECT category AS overtake_category, COUNT(*) AS overtakes_count
FROM overtake_labels
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY CASE category
  WHEN 'R' THEN 1
  WHEN 'P' THEN 2
  WHEN 'S' THEN 3
  WHEN 'T' THEN 4
  ELSE 5
END;

WITH sample_race AS (
    SELECT race_id FROM pit_stops LIMIT 1
),

prev_positions AS (
    SELECT race_id, lap + 1 AS lap, driver_id, position AS prev_position
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE race_id IN (SELECT race_id FROM sample_race)
),

curr_positions AS (
    SELECT race_id, lap, driver_id, position AS curr_position
    FROM lap_positions
    WHERE race_id IN (SELECT race_id FROM sample_race)
),

overtakes AS (
    SELECT
        c.race_id,
        c.lap,
        c.driver_id AS overtaking_driver_id,
        p.driver_id AS overtaken_driver_id
    FROM curr_positions c
    JOIN prev_positions p ON c.race_id = p.race_id AND c.lap = p.lap
    WHERE c.curr_position < p.prev_position
),

classified_overtakes AS (
    SELECT
        o.race_id,
        o.lap,
        o.overtaking_driver_id,
        o.overtaken_driver_id,
        CASE
            WHEN r.driver_id IS NOT NULL AND r.lap = o.lap THEN 'R'
            WHEN pe.race_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'P'
            WHEN px.race_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'P'
            WHEN o.lap = 1
                 AND ABS(qo1.position - qo2.position) <= 2 THEN 'S'
            ELSE 'T'
        END AS overtake_type
    FROM overtakes o
    LEFT JOIN retirements r ON r.race_id = o.race_id AND r.driver_id = o.overtaken_driver_id
    LEFT JOIN pit_stops pe ON pe.race_id = o.race_id AND pe.driver_id = o.overtaken_driver_id AND pe.lap = o.lap
    LEFT JOIN pit_stops px ON px.race_id = o.race_id AND px.driver_id = o.overtaken_driver_id AND px.lap = o.lap - 1
    LEFT JOIN qualifying qo1 ON qo1.race_id = o.race_id AND qo1.driver_id = o.overtaking_driver_id
    LEFT JOIN qualifying qo2 ON qo2.race_id = o.race_id AND qo2.driver_id = o.overtaken_driver_id
    WHERE o.race_id IN (SELECT race_id FROM sample_race)
),

result AS (
    SELECT overtake_type, COUNT(*) AS occurrences
    FROM classified_overtakes
    GROUP BY overtake_type
)

SELECT * FROM result
ORDER BY overtake_type;

WITH driver_season_races AS (
  SELECT 
    d.driver_id, 
    r.year, 
    r.round, 
    res.constructor_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.driver_id, r.year ORDER BY r.round) AS race_order
  FROM results res
  JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
  JOIN drivers d ON res.driver_id = d.driver_id
  WHERE r.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
driver_season_filtered AS (
  SELECT driver_id, year
  FROM driver_season_races
  GROUP BY driver_id, year
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT round) >= 2
),
first_last_constructor AS (
  SELECT 
    dsf.driver_id,
    dsf.year,
    MIN(dsr.race_order) AS first_race_order,
    MAX(dsr.race_order) AS last_race_order
  FROM driver_season_filtered dsf
  JOIN driver_season_races dsr ON dsf.driver_id = dsr.driver_id AND dsf.year = dsr.year
  GROUP BY dsf.driver_id, dsf.year
),
constructor_check AS (
  SELECT 
    flc.driver_id,
    flc.year,
    (SELECT constructor_id FROM driver_season_races dsr2 WHERE dsr2.driver_id = flc.driver_id AND dsr2.year = flc.year AND dsr2.race_order = flc.first_race_order) AS first_constructor_id,
    (SELECT constructor_id FROM driver_season_races dsr3 WHERE dsr3.driver_id = flc.driver_id AND dsr3.year = flc.year AND dsr3.race_order = flc.last_race_order) AS last_constructor_id
  FROM first_last_constructor flc
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname
FROM constructor_check cc
JOIN drivers d ON cc.driver_id = d.driver_id
WHERE cc.first_constructor_id = cc.last_constructor_id
ORDER BY d.driver_id
LIMIT 1000

WITH driver_year_missed AS (
  SELECT
    d.driver_id,
    r.year,
    MIN(r.race_id) AS first_missed_race,
    MAX(r.race_id) AS last_missed_race,
    COUNT(*) AS races_missed
  FROM results res
  JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
  JOIN drivers d ON res.driver_id = d.driver_id
  WHERE res.position IS NULL OR res.position = '' OR res.status_id != 1
  GROUP BY d.driver_id, r.year
  HAVING COUNT(*) < 3
),
constructors_before_after AS (
  SELECT
    dym.driver_id,
    dym.year,
    dym.first_missed_race,
    dym.last_missed_race,
    dym.races_missed,
    (SELECT constructor_id FROM results WHERE driver_id = dym.driver_id AND race_id = (dym.first_missed_race - 1) LIMIT 1) AS constructor_before,
    (SELECT constructor_id FROM results WHERE driver_id = dym.driver_id AND race_id = (dym.last_missed_race + 1) LIMIT 1) AS constructor_after
  FROM driver_year_missed dym
)
SELECT
  AVG(first_missed_race) AS avg_first_round_missed,
  AVG(last_missed_race) AS avg_last_round_missed
FROM constructors_before_after
WHERE races_missed < 3
  AND constructor_before != constructor_after;

WITH lap_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        curr.race_id,
        curr.lap,
        curr.driver_id,
        curr.position AS curr_position,
        prev.position AS prev_position
    FROM lap_positions curr
    JOIN lap_positions prev ON curr.race_id = prev.race_id AND curr.driver_id = prev.driver_id AND curr.lap = prev.lap + 1
    WHERE curr.lap > 1
),
overtaking_events AS (
    SELECT
        lc1.race_id,
        lc1.lap,
        lc1.driver_id AS overtaker,
        lc2.driver_id AS overtaken
    FROM lap_changes lc1
    JOIN lap_changes lc2 ON lc1.race_id = lc2.race_id AND lc1.lap = lc2.lap
    WHERE lc1.curr_position < lc2.curr_position AND lc1.prev_position > lc2.prev_position
),
filtered_overtaking_events AS (
    SELECT oe.*
    FROM overtaking_events oe
    LEFT JOIN pit_stops ps1 ON oe.race_id = ps1.race_id AND oe.overtaker = ps1.driver_id AND (ps1.lap = oe.lap OR ps1.lap = oe.lap - 1)
    LEFT JOIN pit_stops ps2 ON oe.race_id = ps2.race_id AND oe.overtaken = ps2.driver_id AND (ps2.lap = oe.lap OR ps2.lap = oe.lap - 1)
    LEFT JOIN retirements r1 ON oe.race_id = r1.race_id AND oe.overtaker = r1.driver_id
    LEFT JOIN retirements r2 ON oe.race_id = r2.race_id AND oe.overtaken = r2.driver_id
    WHERE ps1.race_id IS NULL AND ps2.race_id IS NULL AND r1.race_id IS NULL AND r2.race_id IS NULL
),
overtakes_count AS (
    SELECT overtaker AS driver_id, COUNT(*) AS overtakes
    FROM filtered_overtaking_events
    GROUP BY overtaker
),
overtaken_count AS (
    SELECT overtaken AS driver_id, COUNT(*) AS overtaken
    FROM filtered_overtaking_events
    GROUP BY overtaken
)
SELECT 
    d.full_name
FROM drivers d
LEFT JOIN overtakes_count o ON d.driver_id = o.driver_id
LEFT JOIN overtaken_count ot ON d.driver_id = ot.driver_id
WHERE COALESCE(ot.overtaken, 0) > COALESCE(o.overtakes, 0)
ORDER BY d.full_name;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
    WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
    WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
    WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
    ELSE 'others'
  END AS age_category,
  COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM mst_users
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY age_category;

WITH first_targets AS (
    SELECT 
        session_id,
        MIN(event_index) AS first_target_index
    FROM (
        SELECT
            session_id,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time) AS event_index,
            path
        FROM activity_log
        WHERE path IN ('/detail', '/complete')
    )
    GROUP BY session_id
), pre_target_events AS (
    SELECT 
        a.session_id,
        a.path,
        a.search_type,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.session_id ORDER BY a.event_time) AS event_index
    FROM activity_log a
    JOIN first_targets f ON a.session_id = f.session_id
    WHERE a.search_type != '' AND
          a.event_time < (SELECT MIN(event_time) FROM activity_log al2 
                          WHERE al2.session_id = a.session_id AND al2.path IN ('/detail', '/complete'))
), pre_count_per_session AS (
    SELECT 
        session_id,
        COUNT(*) AS pre_event_count
    FROM pre_target_events
    GROUP BY session_id
), min_pre_count AS (
    SELECT MIN(pre_event_count) AS min_count FROM pre_count_per_session
), min_sessions AS (
    SELECT session_id FROM pre_count_per_session WHERE pre_event_count = (SELECT min_count FROM min_pre_count)
)
SELECT p.session_id, p.path, p.search_type
FROM pre_target_events p
JOIN min_sessions m ON p.session_id = m.session_id
ORDER BY p.session_id, p.event_index;
